aamon.description: Aamon enters the Camouflage state each time he hits an enemy with a skill, during which he cannot be targeted, restores every 0.6 seconds, and gains 60% extra Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3.5 seconds. Upon leaving the Camouflage state, Aamon immediately resets his Basic Attack's cooldown and a within the next 2.5 seconds. Each enhanced Basic Attack deals and reduces Aamon's skill cooldowns by 0.5 second. The first enhanced Basic Attack's damage is increased to 120% if Aamon leaves the Camouflage state actively.

Passive: Aamon charges his armor each time he casts a skill or hits an enemy with a skill or a. At 5 charges, Aamon throws [6] shards at the target on his next attack, each shard dealing. The shards will then scatter around the target. Active: Aamon throws a shard at a nearby enemy, dealing.

Aamon throws all shards at a designated enemy and slows them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. After a short delay, the shards will fly to the enemy's location again, each dealing –. The number of shards increases with Aamon's armor charges and the shards on the ground (8-25). The damage dealt increases with the target's lost HP, to the maximum when the target's HP is below 30%. The same target takes [50%] less damage from subsequent attacks.

akai.description: Akai gains a for 4 seconds on each skill cast and can marks enemy heroes and Creeps hit by his skills. Akai's Basic Attacks deal extra Physical Damage to mark enemies.

Akai charges in the target direction, dealing to enemies along the away. If Akai hits an enemy hero during this process, he'll knocks them airborne for 0.5 seconds and be able to roll in the Joystick's direction once. Akai can cast Headbutt during Heavy Spin to quickly adjust his position.
Akai smashes the ground with his body, dealing to nearby enemies and slowing them by 45% for 2 seconds.

Akai removes all debuffs on him and spins for 4 seconds, gaining Slow Immunity while continuously dealing to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Enemies heroes knocked back will knock back other heroes they collide with during the process. Akai also gradually increases his Movement Speed to 70% over the duration. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression and Morph effects.

aldous.description: After every 2 Basic Attack, Aldous gains a 500 (+3 × a stack count) shield for 3 seconds on his next Basic Attack. This effect can only be triggered once every 5 seconds.

Aldous unleashes his inner energy to enhance his next Basic Attack to kill enemies and absorb their soul each stack gives to deal Physical Damage equal to plus 5 times the number of Soul Steal stacks. If this attack kills an [Lord/Turtle/]enemy hero/[enemy turret/]Siege Minion/other-non hero unit, Aldous will gain [12/12/10/10/10/4] stacks of Soul Steal|e (up to 650 stacks). The enhanced Basic Attack deals 300% extra Base Damage to Minions and Creeps. Aldous gets extra 5/2 stack) when a nearby enemy Siege Minion/other non-hero unit dies.

Aldous assumes a defensive stance, gaining 30% Damage Reduction and 20% extra Movement Speed for 2 seconds or until manual cancellation. He then deals – to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.5–1 second(s) (scales with defensive stance duration).

Aldous gains vision of all enemy heroes for 5 seconds. During this time, if Aldous uses this skill again, he can dash toward an enemy hero [of choice]. When Aldous hits that enemy hero, he will deal and knock back the target for 1 second. (Aldous can interrupt target's Recall [and Arrival] during the dash.) [Use this skill once again to cancel the dash, and will blink to the designated direction instead.]

alice.description: When Alice's skills hit, she gains 1 stack(s) of Crimson, lasting 4 seconds. Once Crimson reaches 2 stacks, Blood Banquet activates, dealing plus 0.5%~2.5% of the target's Max HP (scales with level) as to nearby units (hitting heroes with skills refreshes the duration) and recovering for Alice every 0.5 seconds. While Blood Banquet is active, Alice gains 8% Movement Speed. Blood Banquet can deal up to 70(+10*Hero Level) to creeps.
Alice fires blood energy forward, dealing. Before the blood energy dissipates, this skill can be cast again to activate Scarlet Shadow, allowing Alice to blink to the blood energy's location.

Alice surrounds herself with blood, gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while slowing herself by 50%. After 1.5 seconds, she descends with force, dealing to all enemies in range and immobilizing them for 1 second. While charging her Ultimate, Alice can only use Scarlet Shadow

alpha.description: When Alpha uses a skill, Beta will be summoned to attack. [Non-minion enemies] that are hit by Beta 2 time(s) will be Locked On|mark. Locked On|mark: After Alpha deals damage to the target, Beta will fire a laser at them, dealing and briefly applying a powerful [90% slow for 0.2 seconds].
Alpha unleashes an energy wave in the target direction, dealing to enemies in its path and slowing them by 40% for 1 second. Beta then strafes enemies along the same path, dealing.
After a short delay, Alpha swings his blade in the target direction, dealing to enemies in a fan-shaped area and recovering for each enemy hit. Beta then strafes enemies in the same area, dealing.

Beta dives into target location, dealing to enemies hit and stunning them for 1 second. Alpha then leaps towards the same location, knocking enemies in his path airborne and carrying them to the landing location. Alpha then slams down, dealing and slowing the enemies by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Beta then strafes enemies in the same area 5 times, dealing.

alucard.description: After each skill cast, Alucard's next Basic Attack allows him to dash to the target's location and deal.
Alucard rolls to the target location and slams his blade on the ground, dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.
Alucard launches a whirling slash, dealing to nearby enemies.

Passive:|e Alucard permanently gains 10%-30% extra Hybrid Lifesteal. Active: Alucard absorbs the energy of enemies in the target area, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% and Hybrid Defense by 10-20. Alucard gains 10-20 Hybrid Defense for each enemy hero hit and reduces the cooldown of his other skills to 50% for 6 seconds. Use Again|e: Alucard releases a shockwave in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit.

angela.description: Angela gains 7.5% extra Movement Speed for 4 seconds each time she casts a skill (up to 30%). When she's attached to an allied hero, the Movement Speed boost is transferred to the allied hero.

Angela sends Love Waves|e in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit, revealing their positions briefly,[duration needed] and applying a stack of Lover's Mark|mark to them (up to 5 stacks). Each stack of Lover's Mark increases the damage by 20% and slows enemies hit by 8% for 3 seconds. The Love Waves|e also restore to allied heroes hit. Angela can store up to 5 charges of this skill and the recharge time is affected by Cooldown Reduction.

Angela launches a Puppet String|e at the target enemy, dealing and gradually slowing them up to 80%. If the enemy is still connected to the string after 3 seconds, they'll be immobilized for 1.5 seconds and dealt. Each stack of Lover's Mark|mark increases the final damage by 20%.

Angela begins channeling [for 2 seconds], applying a that lasts 6 seconds to the target allied hero regardless of distance. After the channeling is complete, she attaches herself to the allied hero for 12 seconds, during which she can cast skills at zero Mana cost. Angela can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling or detach herself from the allied hero. The attaching state will end early if the allied hero is killed.

arlott.description: Arlott possesses a demonic eye that will Mark|e enemy units near Arlott that become affected by control effects for 7s. The eye will also automatically Mark|e a nearby enemy hero every 7s.
Arlott swings his lance forward, dealing and briefly stunning the targets in the area. Targets hit by the further part of the AOE will be stunned for 1s instead.

Arlott charges at an enemy and deals (this skill cannot be interrupted during movement). If Arlott's target is Marked, this skill will deal double damage and refresh its cooldown, and restoring to Arlott (only restores 50% of that amount when used on a non-hero unit).
Arlott cleaves in front of him, dealing to targets in the area and pushing them to the edge of the AOE and breifly revealing their location.

atlas.description: Atlas generates Frigid Breath around him for 5 seconds each time he casts a skill. Enemies who stay in the area over 1.5 seconds will have their Movement Speed gradually reduced|slow until they are frozen|cc for 0.5 seconds. Atlas gains 16-30 extra Physical|Physical Defense and Magic Defense when Frigid Breath is present.
Atlas smashes the ground and causes 3 explosions. Each explosion deals to enemies. Ejected State|e: If Atlas has ejected from his Mecha Sentry, both himself and his Mecha will cast Annihilate.

Atlas enters Ejected State|e, gaining 30% Movement Speed and immunity to slow effects|slow immunity. In this state, the Mecha Sentry will follow the pilot at an increasing speed (can only be controlled by Suppression|cc). Once they meet, Atlas will return to the Mecha, dealing to enemies nearby and stunning|cc them for 1 second. Ejected State|e: Atlas and his Mecha share the same HP bar|HP and reduce 50% of the damage taken|damage reduction in this state.

Atlas hurls chains around and starts to channel (can only be interrupted by suppressing|cc), dealing to enemy heroes hit and slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds. Use this skill again while channeling: Atlas will drag the targets toward him and plunk them down|cc on the designated location, dealing. Use this skill in Ejected State|e: The Mecha Sentry will return to Atlas immediately, but the stun effect will be replaced by 40% slow effect.

aulus.description: After dealing damage, Aulus adds a stack of Fighting Spirit to his axe per second for 4 seconds (up to 6 stacks). Each stack grants% Attack Speed. At max Fighting Spirit stacks, Aulus' Basic Attack is enhanced and gains Attack Range. Enhanced Basic Attack: Aulus slams his axe into the ground, dealing +(% target's Max HP ) to enemies in a line.

Aulus starts accumulating Fighting Spirit, removes all slow effects, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed for 5 seconds. If Aulus does not take high-level control effects within 2 seconds, he will enter the Enraged state and gain Control Immunity

Aulus swings his axe, dealing to enemies in a fan-shaped area and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. Upon hitting an enemy, Aulus can cast this skill again to dash forward and smash the ground, dealing to nearby enemies.

Aulus repeatedly swings his axe at nearby enemies, dealing each time. After 4 strikes, Aulus briefly charges before unleashing a wider slash, dealing to enemies a large area. During this skill, Aulus gains 20-40% Damage Reduction and a short burst of Movement Speed with each slash.

aurora.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Aurora freezes herself for 1.5 seconds, becoming invincible during this time and greadually recovering 30% Max HP. This effect has a 150 seconds cooldown. Aurora's freeze effects can also affect Turrets.
Aurora summons an icy meteorite to strike at the taraget location, dealing and slowing targets hit by 40% for 1 second. Afterward, 5 hailstones fall, each dealing.

badang.description: After every 4 name = Basic Attack, Badang's next Basic Attack deals to enemies hit and knocks them back. Enemies that are knocked into obstacles will be stunned for 0.6s (minions and creeps are stunned directly). Fist Wind generated by Badang's skills can also trigger this effect.

Badang unleashes a gust of Fist Wind in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s, and knocking them back. The Fist Wind will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing to nearby enemies. Fist Wind can trigger attack effects and grants Badang 1 Chivalry Fist stack upon cast. Badang stores up to 2 Fist Wind charges and restores 1 charge every 10.4s.

Badang dashes in the target direction, dealing to enemies in his path while gaining a that lasts 5 seconds. He stops immediately upon hitting an enemy hero, slightly knock back while creating an obstacle that lasts 4 seconds behind them. Enemies hit by the obstacle are dealt. Use Again: Badang removes the obstacle he created.

Badang throws a flurry of punches in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit 9 times over 2.5 seconds (can trigger attack effects). The Fist Wind generated by the punches will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing to nearby enemies. Badang is immune to control effects for the duration.

balmond.description: Balmond recovers 5% Max HP after killing a Minion or Creep, and 20% Max HP after killing a hero.

Balmond charges to the target direction for a set distance or until he hits an enemy hero, dealing to enemies along the way. The enemy hero hit will be knocked back slightly, and will have their Movement Speed reduced by 40% and Physical Defense reduced by 40% for 3 seconds.

Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed that decays over time and spins his axe for 3 seconds, dealing per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times. Each subsequent hit on the same enemy will deal 8.5% increased damage (up to 68%). The Physical Attack bonus portion of the damage can Crit.

bane.description: Bane infuses his weapon with a stack of Tidal Energy|stack each time he uses a skill (up to 2 stacks). Each of his subsequent Basic Attacks consumes a stack to deal Physical Damage equal to plus of the target's Max HP to nearby enemies. (Percent damage dealt based on Max HP Damage Cap against Creeps:. (see Patch Notes 1.7.82 Balance Adjustment))

Bane fires his Crab Claw Cannon in the target direction, dealing to the first enemy hit and then 150%–200% damage to a random enemy behind them (prioritizes enemy heroes). Enemies hit are slowed by% for 1 second. Every 100 Physical Attack that Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 8%.

Bane chugs his ale, recovering plus% of his lost HP and gaining 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5 seconds. Use Again: Bane spits venom in the target direction, dealing (scales up to 200% with charging time) to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Every 100 Magic Power Bane possesses additionally reduces this skill's cooldown by 7%. |spellvamp-ratio-50%

Bane summons a school of sharks to charge in a target direction, dealing, knocking them airborne for 0.6 seconds, and slowing them by 75% (decays over 3 seconds). This skill deals 40% of damage to turrets. |spellvamp-ratio-50%

barats.description: Detona gains a stack of Big Guy|stack for 12 seconds each time it or Barats damages an enemy with their skills (up to 10 stacks). Each stack of Big Guy increases Detona's size, and grants 4–10 extra Hybrid Defense (scales with the level of Detona's Welcome) and 5% extra Resilience. At max stacks, Detona's Basic Attacks will be replaced with Trample|basic attack, which deals to enemies in a circular area, slows them by 40% for 0.2 seconds, and refreshes the duration of Big Guy with each hit.

Detona spits contaminated oil in the target direction, dealing to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Barats then ignites the oil with a firecracker, dealing to enemies in the area. The area of effect of So-Called Teamwork increases with the number of Big Guy stacks.[how much?]

Barats fires two missiles at the target location, dealing and slowing enemies by 40% for 1 second. The missiles expel fumes from their exhausts upon landing, dealing to enemies in a rectangular area and pushing them toward Barats.

After a short delay, Detona charges in the target direction, dealing to the first enemy hit, devouring and suppressing them for 1.2 seconds before spitting them out. If the target hits an enemy hero or a wall after being spit out, the target will cause an explosion, they and nearby enemies will take an additional and be stunned for 1 second. For the duration, Barats becomes immune to control effects. If the channeling is canceled, 60% of the skill cooldown will be refunded. Passive|e: Detona gains 4–10 stacks of Big Guy|stack upon respawn.

baxia.description: Baxia activates the Baxia Mark permanently, reducing the final damage received by 15 (+1 Hero Level). At the same time Baxia's will reduce the enemy hero's Shield and HP Regen by 50% for 4 seconds when hit by his skills.

Baxia retracts himself into his shield and accelerates forward [for 9 seconds]. When hitting an enemy unit, he will deal to it and nearby enemies, stunning the target for 0.8 second and slightly knocking other nearby enemies back. During the process of accelerating forward, use this skill again to launch Baxia upward so that he can cross obstacles and enemy minions. When leaping up, if there is an enemy hero under Baxia, he will strike down this hero, dealing to this hero and nearby enemies, stunning the hit target for 1.5 seconds, and slightly knocking other nearby enemy targets back.

Baxia throws his shield forward that will disappear upon hitting an enemy hero or creeps, dealing to the target and minions on the path. Meanwhile, marks them for 5 seconds and slows them down by 50% for 1 second. The shield disappears upon hitting the first enemy hero or creep. Baxia can cast this skill again [for 5 seconds]. If an enemy hero or creep us hit by the skill, the cooldown will be reduced by 15%.

Baxia holds his shield to the front and begins sprinting frantically, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 10 seconds while leaving a lava path behind. Enemies on the path will take and be slowed by 15% for 0.5 seconds every 0.5 seconds. For the duration, the Damage Reduction effect from Baxia Mark is increased to 240% (85).

beatrix.description: Her extraordinary talent in the field of mechanics allowed Beatrix to produce 4 weapon(s) of truly awe-inspiring firepower. Renner Basic Attack - Longshot: Fire a powerful shot in the enemy's current direction, dealing to the first target hit (this shot can be dodged, or blocked by others. Deals 50% damage|pd to creeps). Beatrix cannot crit, and converts every 1% Critical Chance gained into 2 Physical Attack

Passive: Beatrix can carry 2 weapons at once, and increase her Physical Attack by 5–30. Active: Beatrix takes 0.6 second to swap her primary weapon with the secondary weapon she has slung over her back, gaining an all-new way to attack and Ultimate.
Beatrix: drops and rolls forward (Renner); leaps and nimbly forward (Bennett); rolls ahead sideways (Wesker); slides forward (Nibiru) and fully reloads her current weapon.

Beatrix wields Renner calmly upon the battlefield, aiming at the enemy. When releasing the skill, she deals to the first enemy hit. This skill gets 50% Physical Lifesteal, but is not affected by Spell Vamp. Beatrix can aim up to 20 seconds.

belerick.description: Belerick releases vines in a designated direction, dealing to enemies on the path and slow them down by 25%. Meanwhile, he leaves Ancient Seed on the path, and after 1 second, these seeds will deal to enemies on the path and taunt them for 1.2 seconds. To minions, 80% extra damage will be dealt.

Belerick increases his Movement Speed by 80% and strengthens his next Basic Attack. (The Movement Speed gain will decay in 2 seconds.) This enhanced Basic Attack deals and slows the target by 60% for 1.4 seconds. Belerick also regenerates HP equal to 240 plus 10% of his lost HP. Each time Deadly Thorns is triggered, reduce the cooldown of this skill by 1s.
Belerick conjures spreading vines around him, dealing to enemies in the area 4 times and taunting them for 1.5 seconds.

benedetta.description: When holding down the Basic Attack button, Benedetta enters the Swordout state|state and charges up Sword Intent|e. If the Basic Attack button released after the Sword Intent is fully charged, Benedetta will use Swordout Slash|e in the direction she's facing and dash forward, dealing to enemies on the path (counts as Skill Damage and is reduced to 50% on Minions and Creeps) Benedetta can only use Swordout Slash when her Sword Intent is fully charged and she is in Swordout state by holding down the Basic Attack button. Benedetta also gains Sword Intent by dealing damage with her Basic Attacks and skills.

Benedetta withdraws swiftly and leaves a shadow in front. After a short delay, her shadow slashes forward in a fan-shaped area, dealing and slowing the enemies by 60% for 0.5 seconds. Meanwhile, Benedetta dashes forward to slash, dealing. (If the target is hit by her shadow, damage caused by Benedetta herself will increase to 200%|pd.)

Benedetta raises her weapon to defend, gaining Control Immunity and blocking damage from any source for 0.8 seconds. After this, she stabs in the designated direction, dealing. If Benedetta successfully fends off any damage while defending, she will gain full Sword Intent|e. If she fends off any control effects, her subsequent stab stuns the target for 1.5 seconds.

Benedetta clenches Alecto, dashes forward (Benedetta is untargetable during the dash), and performs a slash after a short delay,[duration needed] detonating the Sword Intent along the path. For 2.5 seconds, the Sword Intent deals up to a total of to enemies within and slows them by 50%.

brody.description: With his Basic Attacks resonated with the Abyss Power within his body, Brody is able to move while winding up his Basic Attack (which will be interrupted when casting skills), at the cost of having longer Basic Attack Animation and lower Attack Speed. Each Basic Attack deals (of which the damage scaling with level cannot be critical), increases Movement Speed by 30% (which will decay rapidly in 1.2 seconds), and inflicts 1 stack of Abyss Mark|Mark on the enemy, capped at 4 stacks. [Marks applied last for 8 seconds.] Each stack of Abyss Mark increases Brody's damage against the target by 5%|pd and his Movement Speed by 5%.

Brody launches a shock wave in the designated direction, dealing, slowing the enemies by 30% for 1.2 seconds, and applying 1 stack of Abyss Mark|mark. As the shock wave travels, for each enemy it hits, it deals an extra 10% damage|physical damage, inflicts extra 5% slow effect, and applies an additional stack of Abyss Mark, capped at 130% damage|physical damage, 45% slow effect, and 4 stacks. This skill deals only 80%-100% damage|physical damage to minions.

Brody dashes to an enemy, dealing to the target, stunning the target for 0.8 seconds, and inflicting 1 stack of Abyss Mark|mark on the target. Upon hitting the target, he is able to move one more time in the movement direction, gaining 45% Movement Speed that will decay rapidly in 1.2 seconds.
Brody locks on all the targets within 8 yard(s), dealing to them. If the target has an Abyss Mark|mark, all Abyss Marks will be reset, dealing for each stack the target has.

bruno.description: Bruno gains 2.5% extra Crit Chance each time he deals damage with his skills (up to 8 stacks). Bruno has higher Physical Attack but only gains 80% extra Attack Speed from all sources.

Bruno kicks a Powerball on his next Basic Attack, dealing to the target, slowing them by 30%, and speeding up 30% for 0.5 seconds. The Powerball then bounces back toward Bruno and lands on the ground. He or allied heroes can retrieve the Powerball for another attack and reduce the cooldown of Flying Tackle by 1 second.
Bruno makes a slide tackle in the target direction dealing to enemies in his path and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. If the Powerball is bouncing back, Bruno also draws the Powerball toward him.

Bruno kicks his Energy Ball at the target enemy hero, and knocking them back. The Energy Ball then bounces between nearby enemies up to 10 times, each time dealing. Each hit also reduces the enemy's Physical Defense by 4%–8% for 8 seconds (up to 3 stacks).

carmilla.description: Each time Carmilla deals damage to an enemy hero, she steals 7–11 Physical Defense & Magic Defense (scales with level) from them. The stolen Physical and Magic Defense can stack up to 5 times and last 5 seconds. However, Carmilla can only steal defense from the same enemy hero once every 5 seconds.

Carmilla summons two Crimson Flowers that circle around her for 5 seconds dealing each time they hit an enemy and slowing them by 10% for 0.8 seconds (the slow effect stacks up to 50%). The circling speed of the Crimson Flowers also increases with each hit.[speed unknown] Carmilla recovers each time a Crimson Flower deals damage (only recovers 30% of that amount when hitting Minions).

Carmilla accumulates Bloodbath Energy, gaining 70% Movement Speed that decays over 4.5 seconds. Use Again: Carmilla unleashes the accumulated Bloodbath Energy on the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing and stunning them for 0.6 seconds. The damage and stun duration scale with the accumulation time (up to 100%).

Carmilla casts Curse of Blood on the target location, slowing enemies hit by 50%. After 0.8 seconds, enemies still within the area will take, and will be immobilized for 1 seconds, slowed by 30% and linked for 5 seconds. When a linked enemy takes damage or becomes controlled, all the other linked targets take 50% of the damage and become controlled for 100% of the duration. Enemies can move away from one another to break the link.[range unknown]

cecilion.description: Cecilion increases his Max Mana by 10 and restores the same amount of Mana his skill hits an enemy target. Cooldown: 1 second. Cecilion has higher Max Mana and Mana Regen, and his skill damage scales with his Max Mana.

Cecilion orders a giant bat to dive in a designated direction, dealing to enemies on the path. The giant bat will stay at its destination and launch another attack, dealing to enemies and triggering Overflowing extra 1 time. In 6 seconds, every time Cecilion casts this skill, the mana cost will be increased by 1.8 time(s) (capped at 4 times). While casting this skill, he also gains 30% Movement Speed for 1 second.

Cecilion summons a pair of claws in a designated location. After a short delay, the claws will move toward each other and pull|cc enemies along the way to the center, dealing and immobilizing|cc them for 1 second.

Cecilion unleashes Blood Demon power [for 6 seconds], increasing his Movement Speed by 60% (decaying rapidly over 1.5 seconds) and gaining immunity to slow effects|slow immunity. Meanwhile, he shoots 40 bolts of blood energy at the enemies nearby, each dealing and slowing them by 3% (up to 30%) for 1 second. Hitting an enemy heals|heal him for 10 and 1% of his lost HP|health.

chang-e.description: Each time Chang'e deals damage to an enemy, she leaves a mark on them. Each mark reduces the target's Movement Speed by 1%, stacking up to 20%.

Chang'e sends an energy sphere in the target direction, dealing to enemies in its path and slowing them by 10% for 1.5 seconds. Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon will send 4 extra energy spheres along with Chang'e's, each dealing 20% damage. The slow effect can stack (up to 20%).

Chang'e summons the Crescent Moon, gaining a permanent and 10% Movement Speed (that lasts until the shield is destroyed). Each time Chang'e casts a skill, she also gains 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5 seconds. Crescent Moon also allows Chang'e's Basic Attacks to deal additional Magic Damage 2 times. Each time Chang'e deals Magic Damage with her Basic Attack and skills, the cooldown of this skill is reduced by 0.2 seconds.

Chang'e fires 30 meteors in the target direction over 4 seconds, each dealing to the first enemy hit. This skill deals 100% extra damage to Minions and Creeps. Chang'e also gains 10% Movement Speed for the duration. Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon also fires meteors along with Chang'e, each dealing 33% damage.

chip.description: Chip starts eating potato chips once every 2 seconds when out of combat, regenerating HP equal to 300 plus 45% of lost HP after finishing a whole bag (requires 4 bites). After eating a bag of chips, Chip will be full and cannot eat again for 5 seconds. (The bite count will be saved if he enters combat before finishing a whole bag)

Chip rams his hovercraft into the ground, dealing Magic Damage equal to plus 4% of the target's Max HP and applying Chip's Mark|e on enemy units hit. Chip gains a upon hitting an enemy hero, which increases by 40% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next Basic Attack will become ranged and also hit all nearby enemies with Chip's Mark|e, detonating the mark to deal and stun each target for 0.6 seconds.

Chip rushes for 2 seconds, gaining up to 65% extra Movement Speed, after which he maintains the max speed for 2 seconds. Chip's next Basic Attack will cause him to charge at the enemy, dealing and knocking them back slightly.

Chip drops the Main Portal on an enemy hero, dealing and briefly slowing them by 25%. the Main Portal deals 2 timesthe damage and immobilizes them for 1 second after a delay. Meanwhile, he creates Connecting Portals|e near allied heroes 10 units away and behind the allied Base. The Main Portal|e and Connecting Portals|e last up to 15 seconds. Connecting Portal|e: Heroes (on both teams) can teleport from Connecting Portals|e to the Main Portal|e, and allied heroes gain Burst Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds and a shield. Main Portal|e: The Main Portal inherits 70% of Chip's attributes. Heroes can stand on the Main Portal|e for 2 seconds to return to the Connecting Portal they came from. Casting skills or launching Basic Attacks will reset the stand time

chou.description: After travelling 5 units, Chou's deals 180% damage on his next Basic Attack (cannot Crit), briefly slows the target by 80% and reduces their Physical Defense by 10(+1*Hero Level) for 3s (up to 2 stacks).

Chou strikes in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit. This skill can be cast 3 times before it goes on coldown. On the 3rd cast, Chou also knocks enemies hit airborne. Hitting an enemy hero with the 3rd cast resets the cooldown of Shunpo.
Chou charges in the target direction gaining Control Immunity and a shield.
Chou strikes the target enemy hero with a roundhouse kick at the target enemy hero, dealing them and knocking them back. Cast this skill again to chase up the target, dealing a total of.

cici.description: Cici generates a stack of Delight after dealing damage, increasing her Movement Speed by 0.75% and Spell Vamp by 0.75% per stack up to 10 times, doubling the effects at full stacks.

Cici uses Yoyo to continuously attack the nearest enemy within range (prioritizing heroes) for 3.5 seconds, hitting them up to 10 times and dealing equal to plus% of the target's Max HP per hit. Cici can move and use other skills during this attack. If there's no enemy hero within the range, Yoyo will attack Turrets or the Base instead. The skill deals 20% extra damage to Minions.

Cici leaps to a target location. If she lands on any unit (not including Turrets and Base), she can leap again in the Joystick's direction. If she lands on an enemy with the first leap, she deals to them.

Cici throws Yoyo at the target enemy hero and links them with another nearby enemy hero, dealing, slowing them by 30%, and pulling them together. During this time, Cici can use Yo-Yo Blitz to attack both linked targets at the same time. If only one is within the range of Yo-Yo Blitz, Cici will attack the target twice, but the damage of the second attack will be reduced to 25%~45%.

claude.description: Dexter launches an extra attack each time Claude's Basic Attack lands, dealing to the same target. Dexter's Basic Attack can also trigger Claude's attack effects with 30% effectiveness.

Claude attacks enemies in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing and reducing their Movement Speed by 20% and Attack Speed by 10%. For each target hit, Claude gains 3% extra Movement and Attack Speed (doubled if the target is an enemy hero, up to 5 stacks) for 6 seconds.

Claude leaves a mirror image of Dexter at a designated location. Dexter’s mirror image automatically attacks enemies. Lasts 5.5 seconds. Claude can activate this skill again to switch places with the mirror image. Dexter's Basic Attack deals and can trigger Claude's attack effects.

Claude and Dexter rapidly fire at the enemies nearby over 3 seconds, dealing to up to two targets each time they shoot. This skill benefits from Claude's Basic Attack effects and grants him a shield that can absorb damage.

clint.description: After each skill cast, Clint's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds penetrates a line of enemies, dealing. This damage can trigger attack effects, and the part affected by Physical Attack can Crit.

Clint fires 5 bullets in quick succession in the target direction, each dealing to the enemy hit. The bullets will spread evenly across enemies in a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullet will take [11%–16%] damage after the first bullet.

Clint shoots a trap net in the target direction, slightly jumping back while dealing to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds. Succesfuly hitting and enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.
Clint launches a grenade in the target direction that explodes in the first enemy hit, dealing and slowing them by 50% for 0.5 seconds. Clint gains a grenade recharge every 10–5 seconds (up to 3).

cyclops.description: Each time Cyclops hits an enemy with his skills, all his skill cooldowns are reduced by 0.5s.
Cyclops casts two Stardust Disks, each dealing to enemies in its path.

Cyclops conjures Starlit Spheres around himself while gaining 30% Movement Speed for 2s. The spheres will automatically seek and attack nearby enemies (prioritizes enemy heroes), exploding on collision and dealing to the enemy. Enemies hit by multiple sphere will take reduced damage after the first hit.
Cyclops creates a Planetary Sphere and sends it after target enemy hero or Creep, dealing and immobilizing them for 1-2s (increases with travel distance).

diggie.description: Upon death, Diggie reverses time and turns to egg form, in which he can continue to move around and gains a new set of skills. He cannot be targeted in egg form and will revive after a period of time.

Diggie flings an owl alarm to the target location. The alarm will then remain stationary for 25 seconds or until it reacts to the first enemy in range, chasing them and exploding upon collision. The explosion deals to nearby enemies and slows them by 30%. Diggie gains 2 stacks of Dangerous Sparks|stack each time an enemy hero is hit by the explosion (up to 60 stacks), each stack increasing the skill's damage by 1%. Diggie loses half the stacks upon death, but can gain 1 stack of Dangerous Sparks each time his skill hits an enemy hero when in the egg form. Up to 5 owl alarms can exist at the same time.

Diggie marks a target enemy hero for 4 seconds and pulls them back to their previous location after the duration ends, dealing and slowing it by 80%. If the enemy moves out of the circle, the pull will be triggered early.
Diggie removes all debuffs on nearby allied heroes (including himself) and grants them and Control Immunity for 3 seconds. He also gains 50% Movement Speed for 0.5 seconds.

dori.description: Dori's skill damage applies a mark to targets for 4.5s. Hitting a marked enemy with a skill again detonates the mark, dealing. Each time Dori casts a skill, she gains 30% Movement Speed for 1s.
Dori gains a shield for 3s, knocking back nearby enemies and dealing.
After a short delay, Dori deals to enemies in the surrounding ring area, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. She also gains 15% Movement Speed for 3s.
After a short delay, Dori deals to enemies in a large ring area, stunning them for 1s.

dyrroth.description: When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he will enhance Burst Strike - Abyss Enhanced and Spectre Step - Abyss Enhanced. After each 2 Basic Attacks, Dyrroth will release Circle Strike|skill, dealing to enemies in the circle and regenerating [50 + 40% of the damage dealt|pd HP] (Circle Strike doesn't have ATK Effect). Each time he hits an enemy hero, the CD of Burst Strike and Spectre Step will be decreased by 1 second.

Dyrroth releases a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals to enemies and slows them by 25% for 1.5 seconds. (The damage decays against the same target and decreases to only 75%|pd on minions.) Abyss Enhanced|skill: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of the original damage|pd, and its slow effect is doubled.

Dyrroth dashes in the designated direction. He will stop when he hits a [non-minion] target, dealing to enemies. When he uses this skill again, he will lock onto a target and release a Fatal Strike, dealing [a total of]. Enemy heroes or creeps hit by Fatal Strike will have their Physical Defense reduced by 40% for 4 seconds. Abyss Enhanced|skill: Fatal Strike will deal 150% of the original damage|pd, slow the target by an extra 90% [for 1 second] and reduce the target's Physical Defense by 60% [instead] for 4 seconds.
After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destrucive strike in the target direction (cannot be interrupted), dealing to enemies along the way and slowing them by 55% for 0.8 seconds.

edith.description: After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become Overloaded for 3 seconds, during which all Basic Attacks will trigger chain lightning, dealing extra Magic Damage equal to to up to 4 enemies. Chain lightning damage against Minions is increased to 150%.

After a 0.75 seconds delay, Edith controls Phylax to launch an earth-shattering blow in a designated direction, dealing to enemies hit (deals 120% damage to Minions and knocking them airborne for 1 second. This skill won't be interrupted by regular control effects (excluding Suppression).

Edith controls Phylax to charge in a the target direction, dealing to enemies along the way. If Phylax hits an enemy hero during this process, it will stop immediately and throw them over its shoulder, dealing.

Passive: When inside Phylax, Edith can accumulate Wrath according to the damage she receives (calculated before damage reduction). Active: Edith ejects herself forward from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies. After that, she takes flight and can perform ranged Basic Attacks, each dealing. Edith also gains new skills in this state. When in flight, Edith gains 350–650 –350–650 extra Shield, 50%–150% extra Attack Speed and 5%-20% Hybrid Lifesteal based on Wrath she accumulated, and converts each point of Extra Physical Defense and Extra Magic Defense into 3.5 Magic Power. The Flight state lasts up to 8–12 seconds.

esmeralda.description: Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals Physical Damage while Frostmoon deals Magic Damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of Frostmoon's damage dealt. Each Basic Attack deals and. The damage dealt by Esmeralda ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP.[amount/conversion rate unknown]

Esmeralda gains and 40% Movement Speed which rapidly decays over its duration for 4 seconds. Meanwhile, she gradually transforms the shields of her nearby enemies into her own shield,[amount unknown] capped at 50% of her Max HP.

Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing and to nearby enemies. Each time she deals damage to a hero, the cooldown of Frostmoon Shield is reduced by 1.5 seconds (damaging non-hero units grants a 0.5 seconds reduction) and the enemy's Movement Speed is reduced by 10% for 1.5 second.

Esmeralda coheres the power of Astrospace into her two weapons - Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the cast range. Use Again|e: Esmeralda casts the Stardust at the target location, dealing, and then blinks to target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1 second.

eudora.description: Eudora's skills inflict Superconductor for 5 seconds on non-minion units hit and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by Superconductor.

Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies within. When hitting targets affected by Superconductor. Eudora forms a lightning chain with the target. gaining 40% Movement Speed during the chain for up to 1 second. The lightning chain deals over time and an additional when it ends. If this hit lands, it reduces the skill's cooldown by 50%.

Eudora hurls an orb of lightning at the target enemy, reducing their Magic Defense by 10-25 for 1.8 seconds, dealing, and stunning them for 1 second. If the target is affected by Superconductor, the lightning orb reduces the Magic Defense of nearby enemies, deals AOE damage centered on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.

Eudora calls down a blast of lightning on the target area, dealing to targets at the center. Then it strikes targets outside the center, dealing. Every time Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by Superconductor, it triggers a Thunderburst centered on the Superconductor target after a short delay, dealing.

fanny.description: During fight, Fanny deals 10%–20% extra damage to enemies hit (scales with flying speed[speed unknown]) and applies a stack of Prey Mark|mark to them (up to 2 stacks) on each attack. Her subsequent skill hits on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack for her. The energy restoration is reduced[amount unknown] if she hits multiple enemy heroes within a short period of time.[duration unknown]
Fanny whirls her blades, dealing to nearby enemies.

Fanny shoots a cable in the target direction that pulls her to the first obstacle hit. She can cast this skill again within 2 seconds until her energy runs out. Each successive cast reduces the skill's energy cost by 2. Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike upon hitting an enemy mid-flight, as long as her energy is sufficient.
Fanny leaps at the target enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing. Each stack of Prey Mark of the target increases this damage by 30%.

faramis.description: Every 4 seconds, Faramis's next skill against enemy heroes and summoned objects generates a soul fragment on the spot. Faramis can absorb the soul fragment to restore and gain 2 extra Magic Power (up to 40 stacks). Upon death, he consumes the absorbed soul fragments to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%). Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance[how much?] to drop soul fragments.

Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3 seconds, gaining 70% extra Movement Speed, 25 extra Physical and Magic Defense, 20% cooldown reduction of this skill, and the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes that come into contact with Faramis in this state are dealt and applied with a Nether Mark|mark. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis drags all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing. Use again to leave the Shadow state early and drags marked enemies toward him. The range of soul fragment absorption is increased while this skill is active.

Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing (splits up to 2 times on enemy hero hits and 1 time on non-enemy hero hits).

Faramis turns his surroundings into the Nether Realm|e for 6s, making affected allied hero (including himself) enter the Specter|e state and granting them plus% extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When Specter|e state breaks, the hero will clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1s. An allied hero's Specter|e state ends when they leave the Nether Realm|e.

floryn.description: Dew's Lantern will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount. After leaving combat for 5 seconds, Floryn can share the Flower of Hope with an allied hero (30 seconds cooldown), which will grant them a each time they are healed by Floryn. Floryn will never sell the Lantern.
Floryn tosses an Energy Seed at a target enemy, dealing. Healing Fruits will then spawn and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring their by.
Floryn casts a blob of energy ahead that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.5 seconds (and revealing their positions briefly).[duration needed]
Floryn resonates with Dew's power, recovering to all allied heroes 2 times no matter where they are. This effect also increases their Shield and HP Regen effects by 12% for 2 seconds.

franco.description: Franco launches an iron hook in the target direction. The hook will snag the first enemy unit hit, dealing dragging them to Franco.

fredrinn.description: Fredrinn gains 1 Combo Point that lasts 5 seconds each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 Combo Points. His Ultimate costs different numbers of Combo Points at different skill levels. Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as Crystal Energy|E, which decays after 5 seconds at a rate of 10% Max HP per second. Fredrinn can convert the stored Crystal Energy|E into HP by 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a Combo Point resets the decaying timer.

Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals.[skill duration needed] This skill deals 200% damage to non-hero enemies.
Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing to the first non-minion enemy hit. His next Basic Attack knocks the target airborne for 0.3 seconds.[skill duration needed]

freya.description: Freya gains 1 Sacred Orb with each Basic Attack (up to 6 Sacred Orbs). Consuming 1 Sacred Orb grants Freya 100% Attack Speed for her next Basic Attack (max 6 stacks). Sacred Orbs gradually recover when out of combat.
Freya leaps to the target area and strikes the ground with her shield, gaining and dealing to enemies within while knocking them airborne for 0.4 seconds.
Freya charges forward and slashes, dealing and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5 seconds. This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 Sacred Orbs per cast. This skill deals 50% damage to creeps.

Freya selects a target area and dives down as a Valkyrie (gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reducion), dealing and 40% slow to enemies in her path and at the landing point for 2 seconds. Upon landing, Freya enters the Valkyrie state for 12 seconds, during which her Basic Attacks deal 30-60 extra damage (extra damage cannot Crit) and she recovers per Basic Attack, and her Basic Attacks deal splash damage.

gatotkaca.description: Gatotkaca gains [1] Physical Defense equal to 2% of his lost HP (up to 100). For every 300 damage he takes (calculated before damage reduction), he gains 5 Rage (up to 100). Upon reaching over 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next Basic Attack becomes enhanced, consuming all Rage to deal extra Magic Damage and recover. The extra damage scales with his Rage, level, and Magic Power.
Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a shattered zone in the target direction while dealing to enemies within. Enemies in the shattered zone will take per second and be slowed by 30%.

Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, forcing enemies on the path to attack him and deal for 1.5 seconds. The sprint distance scales with the channel time. Canceling the Skill reduces 50% of the remaining Cooldown.

Gatotkaca jumps to the target location, dealing to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1 second. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked airborne for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled to the center. The camera will move with the skill indicator but won't grant extra sight.

gloo.description: Enemies gain a stack of Sticky each time they're hit by Gloo's skills, decreasing their Movement Speed by 4% for 6 seconds. Stacks up to 5. Each stack of Sticky on an enemy reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 4%.

Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing to the enemy. At the final, a Goo is left behind that explodes after 3 seconds to deal to nearby enemies and immobilize them for 1 second. If Gloo touches the Goo, it will explode immediately, reset the skill's cooldown, and heal Gloo for 2.5%-5% of Max HP if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if hits an enemy hero).

Gloo splits into Goos, dealing to enemies in a fan-shaped area and immobilizing them for 0.5 seconds. While split, Gloo gains 10% Movement Speed and deals every 0.25 seconds to enemies it touches, lasting 4 seconds. If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo will charge over to merge with it, dragging enemies in its path in the same direction for a distance.

Unlocked when any enemy hero has full Sticky stacks. Gloo attaches itself to the target enemy hero for up to 9 seconds, recovering 25%-30% of its Max HP. For the duration, its Basic Attacks are converted to deal, and it transfers 80% of the damage it receives (excluding damage from turrets) to its host. If the target dies while attached, this skill's cooldown is reduced to 5 seconds.

gord.description: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with Basic Attacks or skills within a short period of time, the next attack on the target will deal an additional and slow them by 20% for 1 second (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).
Gord conjures a Mystic Orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their locations for 1 second.
Gord create an energy field in the target area, dealing every 0.3 second to enemies within (up to 13 times).

granger.description: Granger's unique Demon Hunting Gun and Cannon are powered by Demonic Energy. Both his weapons have a staring Energy cap of 800. His Gun restores 8% Energy per second while his Cannon restores 2% Energy per second. Each Minion / Creep kill will permanently increase the Energy cap of Granger's Gun and Cannon by 6 / 6, and instantly restore their Energy by 5% / 5%, respectively. Every kill or assist on an enemy hero will permanently increase their Energy cap by 12 and instantly restore 10% Energy. Every 1% CD Reduction Granger gains is converted into 2 Physical Attack. Demonic Energy Cost is not affected by Energy Cost Reductions.

Granger rapidly fires 6 shot(s) with his Gun, with each shot dealing and consuming 70 Gun Energy. The last bullet is guaranteed to Crit. Each bullet deals an additional 70 damage to Creeps and Minions. While firing, Granger's Movement Speed is increased by 15%. Granger stops firing when he runs out Energy, or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has a brief cooldown and can be cast once his Gun Energy is over 420.

Granger uses his Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15%-25% Energy for his Gun. Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 second.

Granger fires his Cannon in the target direction, dealing to the first enemy hero hit and other targets in the blast radius. Targets hit will be slowed and revealed for a brief duration. Granger can roll in the Joystick's direction after each shot. Death Sonata can be cast while firing Rhapsody. Death Sonata has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 of Granger's Cannon Energy per shot.

grock.description: Grock gains a Shield equal to 10% of his Max HP and empowers the next Basic Attack to deal equal to% of the target's Max HP (capped at against non-hero units). This effect has a 18-12 seconds cooldown (decreases with level), which reduces by 200% when near terrain. Grock's skills cannot be interrupted and gains% extra Physical Defense while the Shield is active.

Grock strikes forward with massive force, dealing. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked into the obstacle, launched airborne, and take extra equal to% of their Max HP (capped at against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only knocked back slightly.
After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing and knocking enemies towards him. Use Again: Cancel the wall early.

Grock charges forward, dealing to enemies in his path. Upon hitting terrain, he immediately stops and triggers a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies airborne for 1 second and deals. If this skill doesn't hit terrain, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.

gusion.description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next Basic Attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's max HP and restore to himself.

Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing to the first enemy hit and marking them. Use Again|e}: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy, dealing to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.

Gusion throws a volley of [five] daggers in the target direction, each dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2 seconds (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%). Use Again:|e Gusion recalls the daggers, each dealing to enemies in its path.

Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldown of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. If Shadowblade Slaugther was cast once before the reset, Gusion can throw another five daggers on his next Shadowblade Slaughter, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward. Use Again:|e Gusion dashes a short distance in the target location.

hanabi.description: Hanabi's Basic Attacks and Skills will launch Petal Blades after hitting a target, bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies (the first bounce deals 40% of the damage, and subsequent bounces deal 85% of the previous). Bounces from her Basic Attacks inherit a portion of Attack Effects.

Passive:|e The secret Ninjutsu of the Scarlet Shadow makes Hanabi immune to control effects when she has a shield from any source. Active:|e Hanabi gains a for 5 seconds. When the shield is active, Hanabi gains 20% Movement Speed, 25% Attack Speed, and 20% of damage dealt will also be added to this shield (only 10% of the damage dealt to non-hero units). The shield cannot exceed 50% of Hanabi's max HP.

Hanabi fires the energy Kunai in the targeted direction, dealing to enemies along the way and reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 1 second. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing Hanabi's next Bounce Damage from Basic Attacks to deal on them with no damage decay.

Hanabi throws Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8 seconds. After 1 second, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target decays 20% damage.

hanzo.description: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 stacks. Ninjutsu Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full stacks of Dark Ninjutsu.

This skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of Dark Ninjutsu. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP. When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy heroes, he deals, recovers 10%~20% HP, and reduces this skill's cooldown by 60%.

Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving dark mist in front that deals to enemies in the area every 0.5 seconds, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit). The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% Movement Speed.

Hanzo charges into battle as Hanekage, consuming 170 Energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 200 Energy when it's a hero. He gains 15 Energy when attacking a hero, and 45 Energy when attacking the Turtle or the Lord. When Energy runs out, Hanzo's body will be slowly drawn to Hanekage's position. While in Hanekage form, Hanzo's body is invincible, and Hanekage ignores obstacles and gains 50% Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed. Use Again or Upon Death: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body, recovering 16% and becoming untargetable during the return. If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and revealed for 6 seconds.

harith.description: Harith gains insight from his Key. He gains 7% Hybrid Lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

Harith creates a phantom of himself in a distant location. Harith and his phantom will then release Synchro Fission toward each other, dealing to all enemy units on the path. When the 2 energy waves collide, an explosion occurs, dealing to all enmies in the explosion area.

Harith dashes towards the target direction. When he arrives, he steals Magic power from enemy heroes, generates a shield that absorbs at least damage and enhances his next Basic Attack. Harith's enhanced Basic Attack deals and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy with Harith's enhanced Basic Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 3 seconds.

Harith uses his Key to summon the Zaman Force. When the multidimensional rift appears, the cooldown of Chrono Dash is reduced by 4 seconds. The rift initially slows enemy heroes in the area by 70% and will continuously slows enemy heroes by 35% afterwards. If Harith comes into contact with the rift using Chrono Dash, he will absorb the energy within and reduce the cooldown of Synchro Fission by 1 seconds and Chrono Dash by 3 seconds. Harith gains 15% Resilience while on the rift.

harley.description: Harley throws 3-5 waves of cards in the target direction, each dealing 130-210 (+25%Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and granting him 10% extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds on hit (up to 5-10 stacks). Enemies hit more than 3 times will take less damage from subsequent hits.

Harley blinks in the designated direction, leaving a magic hat at his place, increasing his Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds. Use Again: Use again within 4 seconds to return where the hat is and lose the speed boost.

Harley casts a magic ring of fire at the target enemy hero (can be blocked by other heroes), dealing them 200-400 (+60%Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. The magic ring stays around the enemy for 4 seconds, during which Harley can hit the magic ring to damage the enemy with his skills. The magic ring will explode at the end of the duration, dealing 100-200 (+30%Total Magic Power) plus 50% of the enemy's damage taken within the duration as Magic Damage.

hayabusa.description: Hayabusa's attacks apply a stack of Shadow Mark|mark on hit (up to 4 stacks). Each stack lasts 6 seconds and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.

Hayabusa throws three returning shurikens in the target direction, each dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies hit by multiple shurikens take only 30% of the damage after the first hit. Hayabusa restores 10 energy for each non-Minion enemy hit. Passive:|e Hayabusa permanently gains 3%–18% Spell Vamp.

Hayabusa dashes in the target direction and releases four phantoms that travel in separate directions. The phantoms will remain at the end of their paths or attach themselves to the first enemy hero hit, dealing and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero during the dash. Use Again:|e Hayabusa teleports to a phantom's location and reduces the cooldown of Ninjutsu Phantom Shuriken by 1 second. If the phantom is attached to an enemy hero, he also deals to the enemy.

Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks on enemies in the area, each dealing. The attacks prioritize enemies with Shadow Mark|mark and each will consume a mark to deal extra Physical Damage. Does not apply Shadow Mark.

helcurt.description: Helcurt remains in the Prowler|e state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed, and continuously regenerating HP if he has not dealt any damage. He gains 50% extra Attack Speed and 50% extra Movement Speed (decreasing over time) for 4 seconds upon being spotted and leaves Prowler|e state 0.75 second later. Any hero killed after hit by Helcurt leaves a dark fog|e that explodes and spreads with a cooldown of 10 seconds. Helcurt Conceals himself while within the dark fog|e.

Passive|e: When Helcurt is in Prowler|e state, the skill terrifies enemy heroes hit and its cooldown decreases 3 times as fast Active|e: Helcurt blinks to the target location and deals to enemies within the area, reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 0.75s.

Passive:|e Helcurt gains one Deadly Stinger for every 1.5s spent in Prowler|e state or on each Basic Attack. Up to 5 stingers can be stored. Active:|e Helcurt fires all Deadly Stinger forward, each dealing to enemies (Minions and Creeps only take 70% of the damage) Deadly Stinger counts as a Basic Attack, but it cannot Crit.

hilda.description: Hilda gains 60% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and receives a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% Max HP, lasting 3 seconds.

Hilda locks onto an enemy target, each time dealing. Skill can be released 3 times at most. The 2nd attack will deal damage to target's surroundings, and the 3rd attack will knock back the target and surrounding enemies temporarily.

Hilda [leaps forward and] launches a powerful slash on the target enemy, dealing and stunning them for 0.2 seconds. Nearby enemies also take 60% damage. Each stack of Wilderness Mark makes Power of Wildness deal 2.5% of the target's Max HP as extra damage. At max stacks, Power of Wildness deal 20% of the target's Max HP as extra damage.

hirara.description: Hirara has only two skills, representing her two weapons: Meisen-e and Kaerazu. Drag one skill onto the other to cast a combo skill. Hirara has 2 Crimson / Death Energy. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 Crimson / Death Energy. Energy recovery time is the same as the cooldown of Meisen-e. Consuming Energy interrupts the recovery process. Hirara only deals 30(+4*Hero Level)% damage to minions.
Hirara rides the waves using Meisen-e, performing up two joystick dashes (the first dash goes in her facing direction). She deals to enemies hit.

Hirara uses Kaerazu to unleash the Crimson Maple, dealing to enemies in a fan-shaped area. After a short delay, she deals damage again at the target location, dealing 2 times the initial Crimson Maple damage.

hylos.description: Hylos gains 1.5 extra Max HP for every 1 extra Max Mana he possesses. When out of Mana, Hylos can use his HP for skill casts.

Hylos gains 50% Movement Speed and causes his next Basic Attack within 3 seconds to deal to the target, knock back and stun them for 1 second. The extra Movement Speed rapidly decays over the duration and ends after the next Basic Attack.

Hylos releases the Ring of Punishment|E, dealing to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4%–6% and reducing their Attack Speed by 7.5%–15% for 2.5 seconds (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the enemy's damage taken from the Ring of Punishment by 5–20%. The Ring of Punishment consumes 30–150 Mana per second when it's active. Use Again|e; Hylos cancels the Ring of Punishment.

Hylos creates a huge pathway in the target direction, reducing enemies' Movement by 75% for 1 second. The pathway lasts 6 seconds. When on the pathway, Hylos gains Slow Immunity and recovers 3% of his Max HP} per second. Allied heroes moving along the pathway gain 60% extra Movement Speed, while enemy heroes on the pathway will be slowed by 25%.

irithel.description: Irithel and Leo's immaculate teamwork allows her to shoot while moving. Each Basic Attack will shoot 2 crossbow bolt(s) (but takes longer to refill) that deal per bolt (inherits a portion [55%] of Attack Effects). Moving will build up Jungle Heart, up to a maximum of 10 units, and cause the next Basic Attack to unleash 1 additional bolt(s).
Irithel launches a volley of arrows on the target area, dealing to enemies within and reducing their Physical Defense by 15–40 for 3 seconds.
Leo lets out a piercing roar, dealing to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

Irithel order Leo to leap in the target direction and empowers her crossbow for 10 seconds. For the duration, she gains 30 extra Movement Speed and her Basic Attacks shoot enhanced crossbow bolts, dealing to the target and nearby units. Jungle Heart also accumulates faster for the duration.[amount unknown]

ixia.description: Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Starlium Charge|e to enemies on hit. When Ixia performs a Basic Attack on an enemy with two stacks of Starlium Charge, the attack will consume the stacks and be replaced with Siphon Starlium|e, dealing plus to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt by Siphon Starlium (only% against non-hero units). Siphon Starlium can trigger on all enemies in front of Ixia that are within her Basic Attack range, but it cannot critically strike. Ixia's Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal.

Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing to enemies in a rectangular area and slowing enemy heroes by 40%. Upon hitting an enemy hero, Ixia also gains 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds. Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.

Ixia launches a canister of Starlium energy in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies, and pulling enemies in range to the center line after a short delay (approximately 0.5 seconds) and dealing.

Ixia disassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the Barrage|e state for 4 seconds. In this state, Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills can hit enemies in a large fan-shaped area but not outside of it. Ixia's Basic Attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizes heroes), and Siphon Starlium will fire simultaneously with her normal Basic Attacks.

jawhead.description: Jawhead's attacks apply a stack of Mecha Suppression|e on hit (up to 10 stacks). Each stack lasts 3 seconds and increases the damage of Jawhead's Basic Attacks to the enemy by 8%.
Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies over 5 seconds, each missile dealing to the enemy hit.

Jawhead gains 30% Movement Speed and a for S seconds. Use Again:|e Jawhead flings the nearest unit (prioritizes heroes) to the target location, dealing to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Can used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.

Jawhead charges into the target enemy hero, dealing and briefly stunning them.[duration unknown] Enemies around the target are knocked back and dealt the same amount of the damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects during the charge.

johnson.description: When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains a for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 100.0 seconds.
Johnson throws his wrench toward the target location, dealing to enemies in its path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8 seconds.

Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction and slowing them by 20%. Each instance of damage also increases the enemy's subsequent damage taken from the skill by 15% (up to 45%). This damage is increased by 60% against creeps. Johnson can cast Basic Attacks and skills for the duration.

Johnson transforms into a car and begins accelerating over time. An allied hero can use Hop In|e when near Johnson to board the car (only 1 allied hero can ride with Johnson). The car will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or obstacle, dealing – to nearby enemies. stunning them for 0.5–1 second (scales with the car's speed before impact),[speed unknown] and creating an electrified zone at the location. The zone continuously deals and slows enemies within. While in car state, tap Brake to stop immediately or hold Nitrous to continuously gain speed for up to 5 seconds. Johnson's location will be revealed to the enemy for 3 seconds when casting this skill. Passive:|e Johnson's Physical Defense is increased by 10%–30%.

joy.description: Joy becomes Angry!|E each time her skill hits a non-Minion enemy, dealing 100. Magic Damage and increasing her Movement Speed by 60% that decays over 4s (hitting the Leonin Crystal|E will also grant the Movement Speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4s for each target. Joy's Basic Attack will deal.

Joy summons a Leonin Crystal|E at the target location, dealing to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The Leonin Crystal lasts 2 seconds and can be used as a springboard for her second skill, Meow, Rhythm of Joy!.

Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the Leonin Crystal|E allows Joy to cast this skill again within 0.8 seconds and gain 1 Beat Energy. Casting this skill on the beat increases the skill damage by 100% and grants a shield that lasts 3s. This skill can be cast up to 4 times in succession.

Joy increases her Physical & Magic Defense by and gains 30% Movement Speed. Over the next 4s, she pulses 8 times, dealing each time to nearby enemies. Each Meow, Rhythm of Joy!|E cast on the beat increases this skill's damage by 40%. If perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting every beat with Meow, Rhythm of Joy!|E, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active. This skill unlocks when Joy acquires Beat Energy|E. Casting this skill with 3 Beat Energy|E will remove all debuffs on Joy and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.

julian.description: After casting two different skills, Julian enhances his third skill. Casting the enhanced skill makes all his skills go on a 9–6 seconds cooldown (decreases with his level. After casting any skill, his Basic Attacks within the next 5 seconds to deal and pull the target toward him. Casting another skill extends the duration. Julian gains 15% extra Hybrid Lifesteal for 5 seconds each time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 stacks).
Julian hurls a flying scythe in the target direction, dealing to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. The scythe disappears upon hitting a non-minion enemy.
Julian summons a flying sword and dashes in the target direction, dealing to enemies along the way.

kadita.description: Kadita gains the Blessing of the Ocean every 30 seconds. The Blessing is triggered when she takes damage from enemy heroes and lasts 4 seconds, allowing her to recover 65% of the HP Lost within the duration afterward.

Kadita summons an ocean wave to carry herself in the target direction and back, dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction. This skill can pass through obstacles and terrain. Use Again|e: Kadita exits the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.

After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave to erupt at the target location, dealing to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1 second. Kadita can cast this skill during Ocean Ode to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.

Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions, each dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a short period, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing to enemies hit. When diving underground, Kadita cannot be interrupted (excluding Suppression). When underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% Movement Speed.

kagura.description: Upon retrieving the Seimei Umbrella, Kagura gains a, stuns nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds, and slows them by 60% for 1 second. Cooldown 4.5 seconds.

Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing to enemies in its path and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 second. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she's too far away. This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.
Kagura removes all debuffs on her and dashes in the target direction, while leaving the Seimei Umbrella behind.
Kagura invokes the power of the Seimei Umbrella, dealing to nearby enemies, knocking them back, and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 second.

kaja.description: Kaja summons a ring of Primal Lightning that expands and returns to him. Enemies hit take and recover to Kaja. Healing from subsequent hits is reduced to 33%.

Kaja dashes to the target area, gaining Control Immunity during the dash. On arrival, he deals, knocking back and stunning nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds, then enters the Soaring state. The Soaring state lasts 6.6 seconds. During this time, he ignores obstacles and gains 15% Movement Speed, but his turn radius is restricted. He can use Basic Attacks while moving, dealing (+2% target's Max HP ) to surrounding enemies. Upon entering the Soaring state, the cooldown of Soaring Wings 2 is reduced to 4 seconds (unaffected by Cooldown Reduction). Hitting a hero or creep extends the Soaring state by 2.6 seconds.

Kaja hurls a Primal Lightning Laso at the target area. After a 0.5 seconds delay, all enemy heroes remaining in the area take and are trapped for 2.5 seconds. While active, Kaja can drag the lasso, shrinking its radius and pulling enemies at the boundary along with him (does not interrupt their skills).

kalea.description: After casting a skill, Kalea creates a Water Zone on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill within this zone, she will absorb it to enhance her next three Basic Attacks with different effects: First Basic Attack: Kalea dashes to the target, dealing. Second Basic Attack: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing and recovering HP for herself and the nearby lowest HP ally. Third Basic Attack: Kalea uses her tail to strike the area around her target, dealing and creating a new Water Zone. Enhanced Basic Attacks are not affected by Attack Speed.
Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

Kalea charges forward and body slams the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them airborne for 0.6s while dealing. If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a Water Zone during her charge, Kalea will leap into the air. Cast the skill again to slam down at a target location, dealing and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s.
Kalea grabs an enemy hero with her tail and slams them down in the Joystick's direction, dealing to the target and nearby enemies.

karina.description: Karina's third consecutive attack on the same enemy deals extra True Damage equal to 50 plus% of their lost HP (up to 2000 True Damage against creeps). If the target is an enemy hero, the cooldowns Karina's non-Ultimate skills are reduced by 1.5 seconds.

Karina enters the Dance of Blades|e state for 3.5 seconds, during which she gains 45% extra Movement Speed, blocks all incoming Basic Attacks, and reflects back to the attacker (the damage reflection effect has a cooldown of 0.4 seconds). Karina's Basic Attack within the duration deals, slows the target by 45% for 1 second, and is guaranteed critical strike. Casting the enhanced Basic Attack or Shadow Assault ends the Dance of Blades|e state early.
Karina launces a spinning slash, dealing to nearby enemies.

Karina dashes to the target enemy hero, dealing, applying a Shadow Mark|e to them, and leaving a Shadowform|e behind them. The Shadow Mark and Shadowform both last 5 seconds. If the enemy dies within the duration, the cooldown of this skill is reset. Use Again:|e Karina dashes back to the Shadowform|e's location, dealing to enemies along the way.

karrie.description: Karrie's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Lightwheel Mark on hit. Once a target has 5 stacks of Lightwheel Marks, the marks will turn into a lightwheel, dealing True Damage equal to 6%-8% of the target's Max HP to them (only up to 300 damage against Creeps).

Karrie releases a sphere of surging energy in the target direction, dealing to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its max travel distance, continuously dealing to nearby enemies and slowing them by 80% for 1s.

Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing and applying a stack of Lightwheel Mark on them. When in Dual Wield state, Karrie throws two lightwheels instead.

Karrie enters Dual Wield state for 6s, during which she gains 20% Movement Speed and throws two lightwheels with each Basic Attack, each dealing 50-70% Basic Attack damage annd inheriting a portion of Attack Effects.

khaleed.description: Khaleed accumulates Desert Power while moving. After Desert Power is fully charged, he will glide on sand, increasing Movement Speed by 35%, making his next Basic Attack deal to the target (cannot critically strike), and reducing the target's Movement Speed by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
Khaleed whirls his scimitar, dealing to enemies in the area and pulling them toward him. This skill can be used up to 3 time(s) in a row. This skill deals 50%-75% damage to Minions and Creeps.

Khaleed rides the sandstorm and charges toward a designated location, dealing to enemies along the way and knocking them toward his destination. Khaleed is immune to control effects during this process. Upon reaching the destination, Khaleed will smash the ground, dealing to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1 second, and fully charge his Desert Power.

khufra.description: Khufra activates the Spell Curse left by Esmeralda every 12 seconds, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range [Cast Range: 4.9] and deals []. Also slows the target by 30% for 1.5 seconds and heals Khufra by 8% of his Max HP on hit. Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4 seconds.

Khufra pulls the bandage on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing 50–100 plus 7% of his Max HP Physical Damage to all enemy units on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering a first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing 50–100 plus 7% of his Max HP Physical Damage to enemies nearby and then knocking them in the air for up to 1.1 seconds.

Khufra uses bandage to wrap himself into a magic bouncing ball, increasing his own Physical & Magic Defense by 30%–100&. Enemies trying to use blink skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne.[duration needed] Each time the magic bouncing ball hits the ground, it will deal Magic Damage equal to 50–100 plus 3% of his Max HP to enemies nearby and slow them by 80%. Lasts 0.2 seconds.

Khufra pulls back all enemy targets around him toward his front, dealing and slowing them down for 1.25–1.75 seconds. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra Physical Damage equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.

kimmy.description: Kimmy can move and aim in different directions when using her Spray Gun, but cannot lock on to a specific enemy. Kimmy's Spray Gun attack deals. Hitting enemy heroes/non-hero units restores 6/3 Starlium. At max Starlium, Kimmy's Basic Attacks are enhanced to deal damage and pierce through targets. Kimmy doesn't stop moving while shooting and no longer benefits from Attack Speed Bonus. Every 1% Attack Speed she gains is converted to 1 Magic Power.

Kimmy uses her jetpack to take flight, removing and becoming immune to Slow Effects. She can pass through terrain and gains 90% Movement Speed for 1 second. During the flight, she fires 4 Chemical Bolts at nearby enemies, each dealing and slowing them by 50% for 0.5 seconds.
Kimmy fires a Starlium Beam in the target direction that immobilizes enemies in its path and deals for 2 seconds. Gain 20 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.

Kimmy charges and fires a Traction Pulse in a target direction.
