Upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range, it explodes to deal to nearby enemies and creates a force field that slows enemies within by 75%. After 1 second, the field contracts, pulling all enemy heroes to its center and dealing 15% of their current HP as Magic Damage. Gain 40 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.

lancelot.description: Each time Lancelot [blinks or] charges, his damage is increased by 7.5% for 4 seconds, up to 30%.

Lancelot charges in a designated direction, dealing to enemies along the way and applying a Sword Mark to the first unmarked enemy hit. The Sword Mark lasts 3 seconds. If Lancelot successfully applies a Sword Mark to an enemy, the cooldown of this will reset.

Lancelot strikes in the target direction 3 times, each time dealing to enemies hit (damage reduced [to 30%|pd] when multiple enemies are hit). He's untargetable and invincible during this process.[how long?] Enemies in the center of the area will take all 3 hits and are slowed by 20% for 0.5 seconds. The slow effect can stack. This skill only benefits from 50% of Lancelot's Spell Vamp.
After a short period[how long?] of charging, Lancelot performs an executioner's strike in the target direction, dealing. He is invincible throughout the process.[how long?]

lapu-lapu.description: Each time Lapu-Lapu deals damage, he gains 10 Bravery Blessing|rage (halved from non-hero units). When his Bravery Blessing is full, his next Basic Attack or Justice Blades will be enhanced, granting Lapu-Lapu a shield that can absorb damage for 2.5 seconds. The enhanced Basic Attack) will cause him to dash toward the target, dealing. This Basic Attack cannot be a critical hit. The enhanced Justice Blades will slow the target by 60% for 1 second.
Lapu-Lapu releases two boomerangs in the target direction. Each boomerang dealing to enemies hit on its way out and back. Enemies hit by both boomerangs take 50% damage from the second hit.
Lapu-Lapu dashes in the target direction, dealing to enemies along the way.

Lapu-Lapu leaps to the target location while combining his twin blades into one, dealing upon landing and slowing them by 60% for 1 second. Lapu-Lapu Gains 3 times the Bravery Blessing|rage from this skill and skills in transformed state For the next 10 seconds, Lapu-Lapu enters Great Sword Stance|skill) and gains enhanced skills, 30-60 extra Physical & Magic Defense and his Basic Attack damage|Physical Damage is increased to 120%.

layla.description: Layla deals increased damage to enemies farther away from her (starting at 100% and increasing to 130% at 6 units away). This does not include Turrets.

Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing to the first enemy hit (can critically strike). Upon hitting an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and Void Projectile gain extra range for 3 seconds, and she gains 60% Movement Speed that decays over 1.2 seconds. The duration of the Movement Speed boost is doubled if an enemy hero is hit.

Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy that explodes on hit, dealing to targets in the area and applying Magic Mark on them for 3 seconds. When Layla hits an enemy with a Magic Mark, she deals to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing to enemies in a line. Passive: The range of Layla's Void Projectile and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6–1.8 units. Her sight range is also slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded.

leomord.description: Leomord's Basic Attacks and skills grant him 25 Oath Keeper energy each time they deal damage to targets. When this energy reach 100, his next Basic Attack deals 200% Crit Damage and restores. Leomord's Basic Attacks cannot normally Crit, and every 1% Crit Chance is converted into 1% Crit Damage. Mounted State: Each Oath Keeper energy gain is increased by 200%.

Leomord begins channeling [for 1 second], slowing enemies in the target direction by 25%. When the channeling is complete or interrupted, he thrusts his sword in the same direction, dealing up to to enemies hit (scales with channel time)[calculation needed] and slowing them by 40% for 1 second. Leomord can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling and immdiately perform the thrust.
Leomord charges towards a designated direction, dealing to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1 second.

Leomord summons Barbiel to rush to him, dealing base=100-300 to all enemies in its path. If Barbiel comes in contact with Leomord, they will enter the Mounted State, gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2 seconds. Mounted State: Leomord gains a brand-new set of skills, and his Basic Attack can be used while moving and hits a circular area to deal AOE damage. Leomord also gains extra 70 Movement Speed and 30–110 Physical & Magic Defense. This lasts 10 seconds.

lesley.description: If Lesley doesn't take damage for 5 seconds, her next Basic Attack gains extra range and 50% Crit Chance and deals (20% extra damage against minions). Each point of fixed Physical Penetration and each 1% Physical Penetration Lesley acquires is converted into 1% Crit Damage, but her base Crit Damage is reduced to 130%. Lesley's Basic Attack restores 5 points of energy and her Lethal Shot doubles the amount of energy restored. The cooldown of Lethal Shot will activate immediately after Lesley uses a skill.

Lesley enters the Camouflage state, gaining double Energy Regen, 40% extra Movement Speed, and 85–135 extra Physical Attack. The state lasts 3 seconds or until Lesley takes or deals damage. Enemies can detect Lesley's position through distortions of their surroundings.

Lesley throws a tactical grenade in the target direction while slightly jumping back, dealing to enemies in a cone and knocking them back. Lesley can cast this skill during the Ultimate Snipe to cancel the state and immediately fire a Fatal Bullet at the target. The attack is only triggered when there are unfired Fatal Bullets left.

Lesley [gains vision to nearby enemies and can lock] onto the target enemy hero and fires 4 Lethal Bullets|e in succession, each dealing and restoring 10 energy on hit. The Bullets can be blocked by other enemy heroes. If this skill is interrupted, each remaining Bullet reduces the skill cooldown by 10%. Passive:|e Lesley's Crit Chance is increased by 5%–15%.

ling.description: Ling's superb Lightness Skill helps him leap among walls. When resting on the wall, He gains 4 Lightness Points per second when he's on a walland 5 extra Lightness Points each time he deals damage. Ling gains 1.6 times Crit Chance from all sources but only has 140% Critical Damage.

Passive:|e Ling’s Critical Chance is permanently increased by. Active:|e Ling casts his Lightness Skill, leaping onto the designated wall, entering half-stealth|e state, restoring Lightness Points more quickly and gaining 30% Movement Speed. If Ling receives damage, he will leave the half-stealth state. If he is controlled, he will fall onto the ground and be slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. When using this skill to jump from a wall to another, it will reset the Cooldown and refresh the half-stealth state.

Ling charges in a designated direction and stabs the nearby enemies at his destination, dealing. If Ling casts this skill when he is on the wall, he'll dash to the target location on the ground, dealing to enemies within a small area and slowing them down by 30% for 1.5 seconds. If this attack critically strikes, the enemies will be slowed by extra 45% for 0.75 seconds. Defiant Sword is regarded as Basic Attack, can trigger attack effects.

Ling leaps into the air, becoming invincible and gaining 10% extra Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds. He can move freely when in the air. He then lands on the ground, dealing to enemies in the area, knocking those in the center airborne for 1 second, slowing the enemies by 40% for 1.5s afterwards and creating a Sword Field for 8 seconds. Four Tempest of Blades|e will also appear on the edge of the Sword Field. Ling can touch them to reduce the cooldown of Finch Poise by 4 seconds, reset the cooldown of Defiant Sword, and gain 25 Lightness points.

lolita.description: Lolita dashes in the target direction. Her next Basic Attack within 4 seconds will perform a short dash to the target, dealing and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. This damage is doubled against Minions.

Lolita raises her shield and reflects all incoming ranged Basic Attacks and Projectiles in the direction of the shield for 3 seconds. The shield will break after taking damage. The damage and effects from the Unique Passives of an attacker's equipment will not apply to the shield and will not be reflected.

Lolita begins charging for 2 seconds while slowing enemies in a fan-shaped area by 50%. When the charging is complete or is stopped, Lolita slams her hammer on the ground, dealing up to to enemies in the area and stunning them for up to 2 seconds (the damage and stun duration are based on the charge time). Use Again:|e Lolita immediately stops charging and slams her hammer on the ground.

lukas.description: Lukas gains 1 Resolve per second and an additional 2 Resolve when dealing damage to heroes. Lukas consumes 10 Resolve per second while in Sacred Beast form.

Passive: Lukas can enhance Flash Combo with his Basic Attacks up to 2 times, lasting 4s. Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash Pulverize, dealing, plus additional attacks depending on the Vigor consumed (recovers HP equal to 8% of Max HP when hitting a hero): 1 Stack: Lukas briefly stuns the target and spins his tonfa hammers to deal 3 times, pulling the enemy toward him. 2 Stacks: Lukas briefly stuns the target and follows up with 2 attacks that deal per hit. He will then spin his tonfa hammers to deal 3 times (cannot be interrupted).

Lukas dashes in the target direction and turns his next Basic Attack within 4s into Flash Strike. Flash Strike: Lukas blinks behind the enemy, dealing. He then increases his Attack Range, gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed, and summons lightning storms with Basic Attacks to deal extra, lasting for 4s.

Lukas transforms into his Sacred Beast form. While in this state, his base Movement Speed is increased by 30, all attributes are increased by 15%, and his skills gain new effects. Use Again: Lukas in Sacred Beast form fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction that will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing. "All attributes" include HP, Physical Attack, Attack Speed, Physical & Magic Defense and Attack Range.

lunox.description: Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order. When Lunox uses Power of Order|e, she gains 0.5% Spell Vamp for every 1% Magic Penetration. When Lunox uses Power of Chaos|e, she gains 0.5% Magic Penetration for every 1% of Spell Vamp.

Lunox summons a rain of starlight upon nearby enemies, dealing. The starlight then returns to Lunox, each restoring and recovering. The HP restored is doubled when hitting enemy heroes. Grants one stack of Power of Order|e after use.
Lunox unleashes Chaos Energy at an enemy, dealing Magic Damage equal to (1.5%–3% of Max HP against Creeps). Grants one stack of Power of Chaos|e after use.
Lunox extends the Light Barrier, becomes invincible for 2.5 seconds, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed while dealing every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies.

luo-yi.description: Luo Yi's skills create Sigils of Yin/Yang|mark on the battlefield. Each Sigil lasts up to 6 seconds. Sigils opposite attributes will trigger Yin-Yang Reaction|e when they are within a certain distance,[how much?] dealing to the marked [enemy heroes], stunning them for 1 second, and pulling them toward each other. Each time Luo Yi applies a new Sigil to a marked enemy [hero], she gains (up to 3 stacks) and 30% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2 seconds.

Luo Yi casts the energy of Yin/Yang|e in the target direction, dealing to the first enemy hit ad those behind in a cone. Enemy heroes hit are marked with Sigil of Yin/Yang|mark. Luo Yi stores up to 4 Dispersion charges and gains 1 charge every 8 seconds. She also gains 1 charge each time Yin-Yang Reaction|e is triggered. The state of this skill changes on each cast.

Luo Yi summons Fire of Yang/Aqua of Yin|e at a target location, dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 seconds. Fire of Yang/Aqua of Yin then remains at the location for 6 seconds, dealing every 0.7 seconds. It can also trigger Yin-Yang Reaction|e with mark of opposite attributes. The state of this skill changes on each cast.

Active:|e Luo Yi creates a Teleport Circle around herself and marks target location (within 20 units) as its destination. After 3 seconds delay, allied heroes (including herself) within the Circle will be teleported to the location. Passive:|e Luo Yi’s Cooldown Reduction is increased by 6%–10%.

lylia.description: Lylia gets power from Gloom|color=indigo, increasing her movement speed by 15%|ms whenever she is within the area of Gloom|color=indigo. Additionally, every time Gloom|color=indigo is upgraded, her movement speed is increased by 5%|ms, stacking up to 4 times or 20%|ms for a maximum of 35% movement speed increase|ms.

Lylia sends out Gloom|color=indigo in a line, dealing 250 to 500 6 (+100%Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the path and slowing them by 40%|slow for 1.5 seconds. If Gloom|color=indigo touches Shadow Energy, he will devour and detonate it.

Lylia condenses Shadow Energy|enhanced at a location, dealing 100 to 160 6 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 80%|slow for 0.5 seconds. If Shadow Energy|enhanced is detonated by Gloom|color=indigo or Magic Shockwave, it will detonate to deal an additional 250 to 400 6 (+100% Magic Power) Magic Damage and turn the Shadow Energy|enhanced to Gloom|color=indigo for 8 seconds. During this time, Gloom|color=indigo can then detonate additional Shadow Energies|enhanced within his range, resetting his timer and moving to the Shadow Energy|enhanced's location in each instance. Additionally, whenever Gloom|color=indigo detonates a Shadow Energy|enhanced within 8 seconds, the detonation damage is increased by 30%, stacking up to 4 times or 120%. If Gloom|color=indigo detonates 5 Shadow Energies|enhanced consecutively, this skill can deal a maximum of 250*2.2 to 375*2.2 6 (+220% Magic Power) Magic Damage. Stores a charge of Shadow Energy|enhanced every 9 seconds, up to 5 charges. Recharge time is affected by cooldown reduction.

marcel.description: Marcel's split soul, Clemar, enters the camera to freeze the moment. Marcel's Basic Attack deal. His Extra HP is converted into 1.5% Hybrid Defense. Clemar automatically snaps photos of nearby enemy heroes, causing a brief Frozen Moment and dealing 20 + 5% of their Max HP True Damage (triggers Attack Effects). It also grants a shield of the same value to Marcel and a nearby allied hero. Cooldown: 12s per target.
Clemar focuses on an area around Marcel, slowing enemy heroes within 60%. After 2.5s, he completes the shot, dealing to enemies within.

Artist inspiration time! Marcel enters Tracking Haste state for 3s, gaining 15% Movement Speed. This bonus increases to 75% when moving toward an enemy hero. Use Again: Marcel dashes in the target direction, leaving a framing phantom behind while the Framed Moment area remains at the original location.

Marcel and Clemar perform a joint shoot. After a short delay, Clemar takes a wide-angle shot of the target area for 2s. During this time, Marcel enters Tracking Haste state while inside the area. All other units are put into a Frozen Moment and are immune to all effects except from Marcel. All projectiles are also frozen and will continue after a delay (targeted projectiles will deal 50% damage). Golden Hour resets the cooldown of Platinum Snap for each enemy hero. Allied heroes with the Platinum Snap shield can move freely within the area.

martis.description: Each time Martis uses a skill, his Attack Speed will be increased by 30%, 120% maximum. Lasts 4 seconds. He gains (6*Hero Level) extra Attack at full stacks.
Martis draws enemies to a fan-shaped area in front of him and deals, slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

Martis strikes in the target direction three times, each time dealing to enemies hit. Enemies hit by the first and third strike are also knocked back. The attack direction can be changed once using the Joystick. Use Again: Martis leaps in the target direction, dealing to enemies in his path and knocking them airborne. Martis gains Control Immunity and 60% Damage Reduction when casting this skill.

Martis lunges at a designated enemy hero, dealing (deals True Damage if the enemy's HP is below 50%). If the enemy is killed by this skill, Martis can cast the skill again within 10 seconds and gains 100% extra Movement Speed that gradually decays over 5 seconds. Each successive cast also increases the skill's damage by 15% (up to 30%).

masha.description: Blessed by the Bear King, Masha has 3 HP bars and won't die until all of them are depleted. She can ignore an instance of damage each time she loses an HP bar. When Masha only has two HP bars left, skills will only require 50% of their original HP Cost to cast. When Masha only has one HP bar left, she doesn't need to spend HP to cast skills.

Passive:|e Masha gains Power of the Wild which causes her Basic Attack|Basic Attacks to deal extra Physical Damage equal to% of the target's (up to 60 against Creeps and doesn't take effect on Turrets or Base). Active:|e Masha spends 24% HP to increase her Movement Speed by 60% for 1.5 seconds. She also increases the extra Physical Damage from Power of the Wild by% of the target's and gains 50% extra Attack Speed for her next two Basic Attack|Basic Attacks.
Masha spends 24% HP to roar at enemies, dealing and reducing their Attack Speed by 50% for 2 seconds.

Masha spends 34% HP to lunge at an enemy hero (immune to control effects during the lunge), dealing, slowing them by 25% for 2 seconds, and knocking back nearby enemies. The cooldown of this skill will be reset each time Masha loses an HP bar.

mathilda.description: Mathilda gains Ancestral Guidance while moving. When it is fully charged, her next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing to the target and granting her 80 Movement Speed that will decays over 2.5 seconds.

Mathilda resonates with the power of her ancestors for 4 seconds, attracting wisps that as her movement distance increases (up to 6 wisps). At the end of the skill's duration, or when Mathilda cast this skill again, the wisps will seek the attack nearby enemies, each dealing and revealing the enemies' positions briefly.[duration needed] Subsequent damage dealt by wisps to the same target decays to 40%.

Mathilda leaps in the target direction and creates a field around her, gaining a and a 25% extra Movement Speed for 3 seconds. Allied heroes who come in contact with the field will receive 60% shield and Guiding Wind|e. The first allied hero that triggers Guiding Wind will be guided to Mathilda, and both of them will gain the same Movement Speed boost. When casting this skill during Circling Eagle, Mathilda will not change her position. Guiding Wind expires 2 seconds after the hero leaves Mathilda's field.

Mathilda applies a Soul Mark|mark to the target enemy hero and circles around the them for up to 3.5 seconds, during which her wisps will fly toward nearby enemy heroes, each dealing. "Watch me slide forward and increase my Attack Speed for 3 seconds—Ah, that was just boring…" "Muddles, go that way!" "Cuddles, come here!" (The skill's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds each time Melissa damages the enemy by attacking Muddles.)

minotaur.description: When Minotaur uses a skill, he will gain Motivation for 3 seconds and heal himself for% of damage dealt by enemy heroes. These effects are doubled in Enraged state.

Minotaur jumps to the target location, dealing to enemies in the area and briefly knocking them airborne. Enemies hit will be slowed by 40% while enhancing his Minotaur enhances his Basic Attacks to deal extra Physical Damage for 2 seconds. Enraged: Increases the AOE range and the damage dealt by Physical Damage.
Minotaur motivates himself and nearby most wounded hero, restoring for them and healing himself based on his [8%][verification needed] lost HP|HP. Enraged: Minotaur heals himself and nearby allies.

Minotaur enters Enraged State|e and smashes the ground 3 times. The first 2 hits deal to nearby enemies and slow them by 60% while the final hit deals, while knocks targets airborne for 0.8 seconds. minsitthar.description: Minsitthar's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Mark of the King|mark, up to 5 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, the next attack detonates all Mark of the King stacks, dealing and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds while healing Minsitthar for. Can only trigger once every 6 seconds on the same target.

Minsitthar thrusts forward with the Spear of Glory, dealing and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the tip of the spear will be stunned for 0.6 seconds. After a short delay, Minsitthar pulls back the spear, dealing to all enemies along the way and dragging enemy heroes hit to him.

Minsitthar awakens the power in his shield and releases it, dealing to all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (decaying rapidly over 2 seconds). Meanwhile, he enters Phalanx|e state for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken from the front by 25%–50% and enhancing his Basic Attack to swiftly strike an area in front of him for per hit.

Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 Royal Guards to form a field around him. The Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies in the field for. Enemies in the field are slowed by 20% and cannot use movement skills.

miya.description: Miya shoots two extra arrows with each Basic Attack, dealing to the target enemy and 30% damage to nearby targets. This effect lasts 4 seconds. Each extra arrow inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

Miya launches an empowered arrow on the target area, dealing to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds. The arrow then splits into 6 scattering minor arrows, each dealing to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

Miya removes all debuffs on her and conceals herself, gaining 65% extra Movement Speed. This state lasts 2 seconds or until she launches an attack. Miya gains full stacks of Moon Blessing upon leaving the state.

moskov.description: Moskov's Basic Attacks can penetrate the target and deal [(+ Physical Attack) ] to enemies behind them (inherits Attack Effects). Each Basic Attack hit reduces the cooldowns of Abyss Walker and Spear of Misery by 0.5 seconds.
Moskov teleports to the target location, increasing his Attack Speed to 1.15–1.5 times for 3 seconds. Meanwhile, his Basic Attack deals 10% more damage to enemies behind the primary target.

Moskov launches a powerful strike at the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing, knocking them back, and revealing their position for 5 seconds. If the target collides with an enemy hero when knocked back, they'll both take and be stunned for 1.5 seconds. If the enemy is knocked into a wall, they will also be stunned for the same duration.

After a short delay, Moskov throws the Spear of Destruction|e in the target direction, dealing to enemies in its path and to the first enemy hero hit. Upon hitting an enemy hero, the spear pierces them dealing to enemies behind them. The target and enemies hit by the piercing damage are slowed by 50% for 1 second (the slow duration scales with the spear's travel time, up to 3 seconds). When the Spear of Destruction hits the first enemy hero, it creates a shadow behind them and refreshes the cooldown of Abyss Walker Use Again:|e Moskov casts Abyss Walker from the shadow's location (shares he same cooldown as the normal skill.

nana.description: Nana hurls her Magical Boomerang in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies hit on its way out and back. The boomerang deals to the first enemy For every additional enemy hit, the damage is reduced by 20% (max reduction of 60%).

Nana summons Molina at the target location. After a short delay. Molina will chase the nearest enemy hero in range for 2.5 seconds. Molina Will deal to the first enemy hero it collides with and transform them for 1.5 seconds, and also slow them by 50% and reduce their Magic Defense by 25% for the duration. If there are no enemy heroes in range, Molina will disappear after 12 seconds.
Nana summons Molina to strike the target area 3 times, each time dealing to enemies within the area and slowing them by 50% for 1 second. Enemies hit consecutively will be stunned for 1 second.

natalia.description: If Natalia stays in a bush without taking damage for 1 second, she will enter Camouflage state and gain 15% Movement Speed. In this state, Natalia's next Basic Attack will teleport her behind her target and deal while silencing the target for 0.25 seconds. Dealing damage, taking damage or using skills will immediately end the Camouflage state, but her next Basic Attack will remain enhanced for another 1 second. Natalia's base Crit Damage is reduced to 150%, but her damage to Creeps is increased to 150%.
Natalia dashes in the target direction, dealing to enemies in her path. After hitting an enemy, she can cast this skill again within 5 seconds.
Natalia releases a Smoke Bomb at her location, slowing enemies within by 25%–75% while Natalia becomes immune to enemy Basic Attacks for 4 seconds.

Passive|e: Natalia gains 15%–45% extra Crit Chance. Active|e: Natalia immediately enters Assassin Instinct state. Natalia can store up to 2 charges of her Ultimate and each charge has a recharge time of 30 seconds. Creep kills will reduce the current remaining recharge time 50% of the full recharge time.

natan.description: Natan gains a stack of Entanglement each time he or his Reverse-Clone hits an enemy with a skill (up to 6 stacks). Each stack lasts 2.5 seconds and grants 7.5% extra Attack Speed and 5% Movement Speed. Natan's Basic Attack projectiles will return to Natan after reaching the maximum range, dealing an extra 30 to enemies along the way (inherits 60% of Natan's attack effects). Hitting an enemy refreshes Entanglement's duration.
Natan shoots a dense mass of energy, dealing to enemies along its path.

Natan launches a Gravitational Attractor which carries enemies on contact along the path and deals to them. The attractor explodes upon reaching the end, knocking back nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.1 second, and dealing to them.

Natan summons a Reverse-Clone|e at a target location 6 units away that lasts 10s, inherits 35% / 37.5% / 40% of his attack attributes (and 35% of Natan's attack effects), and will copy his moves and attacks in reverse. Use Again: Natan switches places with the Reverse-Clone. [Cooldown: 12 seconds.] Each cast reduces other skills' remaining cooldowns|cooldown by 50%. The Reverse-Clone will disappear if Natan is too far away.

nolan.description: Nolan's skills will leave a Rift|e that lasts 5 seconds and slows enemies by 30%. When a rift comes into contact with another rift, they will activate and pull enemies to their center and deal after a short delay. Each time a rift activation hits an enemy hero or Creep, Nolan will gain 15 Energy and heals for himself. If an enemy is hit by multiple rift activations, the damage after the first hit will be reduced to 40%. Cosmic Leap:|e If Nolan does not deal or take damage for 5 seconds, he enhances his next Basic Attack to dash to the target, dealing and leaving a rift. (Damage to and from Minions or Creeps will not prevent Nolan from getting this effect.)
Nolan cuts a rectangular area in front of him with his cosmic gauge, dealing and leaving a rift at the first enemy hit.
Nolan charges in the target direction and slashes with his cosmic gauge, dealing to enemies in his path and leaving a Rift|e.
Nolan slashes the target location 3 times, with each slash while leaving 3 Rifts|e and slowing the target hit by 30% for 0.5s. The rifts will be activated automatically while Nolan dashes backwards.

novaria.description: Astral Spheres|e summoned by Novaria will continuously slow nearby enemies by 20% and grant vision of them [for 2 seconds].

Novaria summons an Astral Sphere|e at the target location. continuously dealing to nearby enemies [six times]. After 2 seconds, the sphere will explode, dealing to nearby enemies, and increasing Astral Sphere's slow effect to 2.5 times the original slow effect (50% slow).

Novaria summons an Astral Sphere|e at a distance and draws it towards her. At the same time, Novaria gains 80% Movement Speed (decays to 30% Movement Speed over time) and can pass through terrain. When the Astral Sphere reaches Novaria, she can launch it in a target direction within 5 seconds. The sphere will explode when hitting an enemy hero, dealing. The damage will increase based on the Astral Sphere's travel distance (starting from when the sphere is summoned) up to 2.2 times (120%) the original.

Novaria scatters Astral Echo in the target direction, briefly slowing enemy heroes hit by 50% (for approximately 0.8 seconds) while applying Astral Ring|e on them, increasing their hitbox by 2.5 times and revealing their surrounding area. This effect lasts 5 seconds.

obsidia.description: When Obsidia deals damage to enemies, she gains Bone Energy (Basic Attacks against non-hero units grant 1 Energy, against hero units grant 2 Energy, and skills grant 3 times the Energy. No Energy is gained from hitting creeps). When Bone Energy reaches 30, it forms a Bone Shard, up to 25 shards. When Obsidia uses Basic Attacks, all Bone Shards strike the target, each dealing (7% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inheriting 7% Attack Effects.
Obsidia launches an Abyssal Bone Needle dealing to enemies hit and triggering Return to Bone on the first enemy hero attack.
Obsidia descends into the Abyss and enters Shadowmeld Form, gaining 500% Movement Speed for 0.3s.

Obsidia shoots Bones of Wrath, in the target direction, dealing and briefly stunning the first enemy hero hit, and pulls herself near them. The Bones of Wrath then tether to the enemy, preventing Obsidia from moving more than 4 units away from them. The enemy cannot use displacement skills, and their movement will pull Obsidia along. During this time, Obsidia gains 5 temporary Bone Shard(s). This effect lasts 3s. During this time, Obsidia can move through obstacles and use Basic Attacks while moving. Phantom Shadowmeld is enhanced, with its duration increased to 1s and cooldown reduced to 33%.

odette.description: After each skill cast, Odette's next Basic Attack or skill will cast a sound wave that rebounds between her and enemies, each bounce dealing.
Odette concentrates energy to summon a swan to attack enemies, dealing and slowing them by 30%. Lasts 2 seconds.

Odette releases a set of magic energy balls forward, dealing to the enemy hit and immobilizing|cc them for 1.5 seconds. Another energy ball will then spawn and attack a nearby enemy (prioritizes enemy heroes), dealing and immobilizing|cc them for 1.5 seconds.

Odette gathers energy and began channeling, gaining a, and dealing in total to enemies within the area for 5 seconds. (She deals damage every 0.5s). The rebounding speed and count of Lakeshore Ambience's sound wave in the area are also enhanced when the skill is active. Use Again: within 5s to leap in the designated direction without interrupting the channeling. This skill requires constant channeling and will be interrupted if Odette is controlled by high lvl CC such as Suppression, affected by airborne, is transformed or etc or when Odette performs other actions.

He then throws a haymaker, dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 75% for 1 second, as he darts backward. Champ Stance:|e Instead of a haymaker, Paquito launches an uppercut after the elbow strike, to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.5 seconds.

pharsa.description: Every 8 seconds, Verri enters the Hunting state and assists Pharsa on her next attack against an enemy hero, dealing 8% extra Magic Damage equal to the target's Max HP (+1% for every 200 Magic Power owned) and slowing them by 60% for 1 second.

Pharsa unleashes a blast of magic at the target location, dealing to enemies hit and marking them for 4 seconds. Pharsa's subsequent attack against marked enemies will consume the mark and stun them for 1 second.
Pharsa releases magic energy in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit.

Passive: Each level up of this skill reduces the Spiritual Unity's interval by 1 second. Active: Pharsa takes flight for 8 seconds and bombards the target location, dealing to enemies within the area. This skill can be cast up to 4 times within the duration.

phoveus.description: Phoveus' next Basic Attack allows him to charge at the enemy, knocking them back, dealing extra equal to 4% of the enemy's Max HP, and gaining a Shield equal to 8% of his Max Hp. This effect has a 26-14 seconds cooldown (based on Infernal Pursuit level). Astaros' Gaze|e: Whenever an enemy hero blink, dashes, or is displaced within 8 units of Phoveus, the cooldown of Demonic Force will be reduced by 20% and the cooldown of his other skills will be reduced by 0.5 second.

Phoveus slams his monolith into the ground, dealing to enemies in the area and slowing them by 70% for 0.5 second. If this skills hits an enemy, Phoveus' next Demonic Impact will leave behind an Astaros Eye. Astaros Eye: Implodes after a short delay, dealing to the enemies.
Phoveus drops the stone and releases his demonic power in the target direction, knocking enemies airborne, dragging them along, and dealing.

The HP recovered is reduced by 80% when hitting multiple enemies.

popol-and-kupa.description: Popol's good care allows Kupa to recover 10% Max HP per second after not taking damage for 5 seconds. When Kupa is down, Popol can pray for 3 seconds to bring it back to the battlefield. Cooldown: 30 seconds. After launching 3 consecutive attacks on the enemy, Kupa will enhance Popol's Enhanced Basic Attack (Popol and Kupa), allowing him to deal on hit. Popol and Kupa enter the Enraged state|state for 12 seconds: Popol and Kupa both gain 15% extra Movement Speed and increase their Attack Speed to 1.3 times. Kupa turns into the Alpha Wolf Form|e, gains, and enhances its other skills. Also fully restores its HP.

rafaela.description: At regular intervals, Rafaela can use a special skill to instantly resurrect a fallen allied hero after a brief channeling. The resurrected allied hero will respawn at the base and is granted increased Movement Speed. This skill's cooldown is determined by both its base cooldown and the remaining respawn time of the revived hero. It is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies With Light of Retribution, dealing them, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by Light of Retribution again within 5 seconds will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

Rafaela calls upon Holy Light|e, restoring to nearby allied heroes, plus and additional to herself and the most injured allied hero in range. Also increases Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1 seconds. Every 20 point(s) of Magic Power will add 1% to the Movement Speed bonus, up to 80%.
Rafaela unleashes the true power of Holy Light|e in the target direction, dealing to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

roger.description: Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms. In human form, Roger's Basic Attacks and skills deal additional damage equal to [(+target's 4% Current HP)|HP.] In wolf form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to [(+target's 4% Lost HP)|HP.] This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against Creeps.

Roger fires two quick shots in the target direction, dealing in total to the enemy hit. The first shot is a hunter net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5 seconds, while the second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's Physical Defense by for 5 seconds.
Roger gains 20%–40% Movement Speed and 20%–40% Attack Speed for 2.5 seconds.

Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing to enemies hit and slowing enemies by 90% for 0.8 seconds. Passive:|e In Wolf form, Roger gains 20–65 Physical and Magic Defense and 25 Movement Speed.

ruby.description: Ruby gains 6%-20% Spell Vamp (based on level) and inherits 125% Spell Vamp Ratio (Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal). After each skill cast, Ruby can dash to another location, gaining Physical & Magic Defense (scales with level) for 4 seconds. (stacks up to 3 times).
Ruby swings her scythe, dealing to enemies hit. She then unleashes a shockwave In the same direction, dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1 second.
Ruby swings her scythe herself twice, each swing dealing to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5 seconds, and slowly pulling them toward her.
Ruby sweeps scythe in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit, pulling them toward her, and stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

saber.description: Saber shoots out 5 swords that orbit around him, dealing to enemies on contact. After orbiting around Saber for roughly 5 seconds, the swords will fly back to Saber. Within the duration of this skill, when Saber deals damage with his Basic Attacks or skills, he will send an orbiting sword towards the target, dealing to the main target and 50% of the damage to other targets it passes through and reducing the cooldown of Charge by 1 second. It deals only 50% damage to all non-hero enemies such as minions and creeps.

Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing to enemies along the way while enhancing his next Basic Attack. Saber can dash to the target, and his enhanced Basic Attack deals and slows the target by 60% for 1 second.
Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2 seconds and striking them 3 times over the duration. The first two strikes deal each, while the third strike deals.

selena.description: Selena can switch freely between her two forms. Elven Form|e: Selena applies "Abyssal Mark"|e with her skills. The mark can stack up to 2 times. When Abyssal Trap hits an enemy, it immediately adds an "Abyssal Mark". Abyssal Form|e: All damage will consume 1 stack of "Abyssal Mark" to deal extra Magic Damage. "Abyssal Mark" deals 285% extra damage to non-hero units.

Selena summons an Abyssal Devil to lurk in a designated location. The Abyssal Devil will attach itself to any enemy that approaches the location and slow them by 50%. After 3 seconds, the Abyssal Devil deals to the enemy and other nearby enemies and slows them by 50% for 1 second. The Abyssal Devil lasts up to 60 seconds. Up to 3 Abyssal Devils can exist at the same time. Each extra Abyssal Devil increases the final damage by 50%.

Selena fires magic arrows in a designated direction, dealing to to the first enemy hero hit and stunning it for 0.5 seconds to 2.5 seconds. Stun duration and damage increase with the distance that the arrows travel. The arrow absorbs Abyssal Trap as it travels and hence will apply effects of "Abyssal Traps" to the enemy target upon hit. If an enemy is stunned for 0.9 second or longer, Selena's Movement Speed will be increased by 40% for 2 seconds.

Selena enters Abyssal Form and increases her Movement Speed by 30% for 0.8 seconds. Immediately resets the CD of Soul Eater and Garotte. Abyssal Form|e: Selena gains new skills. Her Basic Attack will deal extra Magic Damage. Passive: Selena gains 5-20 extra Magic Power.

silvanna.description: Silvanna's Basic Attacks deal. Silvanna's attacks apply a mark on enemy heroes for 5 seconds on hit, each mark reducing their Physical & Magic Defense by 3–6 (up to 5 stacks). Silvanna deals 30% extra damage to enemy heroes with the max number of marks.
Silvanna dashes forward. Upon reaching the max range or hitting a non-minion enemy, she swings her lance, dealing to nearby enemies and stunning them for 1 second.

Silvanna leaps to the target location and creates a Circle of Light upon landing, dealing to enemies in the area, slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds, and restraining the closest enemy hero to the area for 3.5 seconds. (This skill cannot be interrupted) Silvanna gains 100% [extra] Attack Speed and 40% [extra] Lifesteal when in the Circle.

sora.description: Sora can ascend to Thunder or Torrent by using his Shifting Skies. After ascending, dealing damage to heroes or summoned units grants 1 stack of Cloudstep. At 5 stacks, he unlocks his True Art. Thunder: Converts 30% Max HP into Physical Attack at 10% ratio, adopting an assassin style. Torrent: Converts each point of Physical Attack into 10 Max HP, adopting a tank style.
Sora strikes twice, dealing, then lunges forward, dealing. He can dash after striking.

Sora leaps forward, dealing. If he hits an enemy hero or reaches max range, he slams the ground, dealing an additional and slowing them by 40% for 0.5 seconds. Successful hits reduce the cooldown by 2 seconds.

Swipe left to ascend into Thunder for 10 seconds. Sora gains brief bonus Movement Speed and becomes untargetable. He then summons lightning to strike nearby enemies 3 time(s), dealing with each strike. Swipe right to ascend into Torrent for 10 seconds. After a brief delay, Sora pulls in nearby enemies and deals.

sun.description: Enemies hit by Sun and his Doppelgangers will have their Physical Defense reduced by 5% (stacks up to 6 times). Sun recovers HP equal to 75 plus 25% of the Doppelganger's Physical Attack each time a Doppelganger deals damage. Sun and his Doppelgangers' Basic Attacks deal 50 extra damage to Creeps.

Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing to enemies in its path. Upon hitting an enemy hero or Creep, or reaching the maximum range, the Golden Staff morphs into a Doppelganger that lasts 5 seconds and inherits 40%–55% of Sun's attributes (and a portion of his Attack Effects). Endless Variety and Swift Exchange are learned and upgraded together and share the same cooldown.

Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing to enemies in its path. He conjures a Doppelganger at his location that lasts 5 seconds and inherits 40%–55% of his attributes (and a portion of Attack Effects). Meanwhile, Sun conceals himself, and moves with the Golden Staff.
Sun summons a Doppelganger that lasts 8 seconds and inherits 70%&nash;100% of his attributes and a portion of his Attack Effects. The Doppelganger takes increased damage.

suyou.description: Tap-casting any skill will put Suyou in his Mortal form, grant him 40 Movement Speed and decreasing the interval between Basic Attacks. Hold-casting any skill will put Suyou in his Immortal form, increasing the damage of Basic Attacks to 125% and granting him 20% Physical Damage Reduction. In this form, for every 20 extra Physical Attack Suyou has, he gains 1% Physical Damage Reduction (up to 40%).

Tap: Suyou throws his weapon in the target direction, dealing to enemies in its path. Suyou then blinks to the weapon's location, catches it, and performs a slash in the opposite direction, dealing. Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power and charges in the target direction, dealing to enemies along the path. When hitting an enemy hero, he stops and stuns enemies in a rectangular area in front for 0.6 seconds. The charge increase distance increases with the hold time. Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.

Tap: Suyou performs a sweeping attack with his weapon, dealing [] to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power to perform 3 cleaves in a fan-shaped area. The first two strikes deal each, while the final strike deals and recovers for himself.

terizla.description: Terizla gains 1% extra Damage Reduction (up to%) for every 2.5% HP lost. He cannot gain extra Attack Speed and will convert every 1% extra Attack Speed he's supposed to recieve into 1 extra Physical Attack.

Terizla cracks the ground with his hammer and the fissure will spread out, dealing. After the fissure hits the first target, it will drill into the target and slow them by 30%. At the same time, Terizla's Movement Speed will be increased by 15-40% for 3.5 seconds. The fissure on target will then explode, dealing.

Terizla swings his hammer in a fan-shaped area ahead. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The first two attacks deal each, while the third deals. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 20% for 1.5 seconds (the Slowing Effect can stack). Deals only 80-100% damage to Minions.

Terizla jumps to the designated area, dealing and knocking enemies airborne by 0.6 seconds. He then summons Scaffold and slows enemies by 25-45%. Scaffold will send out a hook at enemy heroes in range and pull them several times while dealing each time.

thamuz.description: Thamuz's Basic Attacks have a 10%-60% chance (based on Lava's Rage) to conjure Lava Energy beneath the target that erupts after a brief delay, dealing. Basic Attacks that don't trigger Lava Energy will increase Thamuz's Lava Rage. When without Scythes, Thamuz gains 25% Movement Speed. After retrieving his Scythes, his next Basic Attack slows the target by 30% and is guaranteed to trigger Lava Energy

Thamuz jumps to a designated area to deal and slow the enemy units by 25% for 2 seconds upon landing. If the scythes are still travelling, they will return to Thamuz and Molten Scythes will reset its CD instantly.

Thamuz spouts the lava stored in his body, dealing to nearby enemies and creating a Cauterant Inferno around him. The Cauterant Inferno lasts 9 seconds and deals every 0.5 seconds to enemies in the area. Meanwhile, Thamuz gains extra Max HP, heals himself by the same amount, and increases his Attack Speed by 60%-100%. He also recovers 1.5%-2.5% Max HP each time he deals damage with Basic Attacks or his Scythes.

tigreal.description: Tigreal gains a stack of Fearless each time he casts a skills or is hit by Basic Attack. After getting 4 stacks, Tigreal will consume all Fearless stacks to block the next incoming Basic Attack (including attacks from turrets). Attacks from Minions do not grant Fearless atacks nor trigger this effect.
Tigreal smashes the ground with his hammer and sends a shockwave forward that erupts 3 times, each time dealing to enemies along the fan-shaped area and slowing them by 20%/40%/60% for 1.5 seconds.

Tigreal charges in a target direction, dealing to enemies along the way and pushing them to the end of the charge. Used Again:|e Tigreal can cast this skill again within 4 seconds, dealing to enemies in front of him and knocking them airborne for 1 second.

Tigreal unleashes the power of his hammer, stunning and pulling nearby enemies to him for 2 seconds while dealing. The first half of the channeling can be interrupted by control effects. The second part of the channeling cannot be interrupted except by Suppression.

uranus.description: Uranus absorbs the energy generated by incoming attacks to strengthen theirself, regenerating a certain amount of HP every 0.8s. Each stack lasts 10s. When at max stacks (20), Uranus regenerates 48-224 HP (scales with level).

Uranus releases two energy blades that orbit around them, dealing to enemy targets and slowing them by 30% for 2s. Each time this skill deals damage to a target, they will be marked with stack for 6s (max of 1 stack per target per cast). Each stack increases the damage of this skill by 40% (to a max of 320%). Each energy blade will only deal damage to the same target once.

Uranus charges to the target location, dealing to enemies along the way, and to enemies at the target location and slowing them by 25%. Uranus also generates a for 4s. The shield explodes at the end of its duration or when destroyed, dealing to enemies nearby.

Uranus unleashes the energy stored within their body, removing slow effects on himself, recovering 200-400 HP, and gaining 60% Movement Speed for 8s (decays over time). Uranus directly gains 5-15 stacks of Radiance, increasing shields received and HP Regen by 20% for 8s.

vale.description: Vale gains 1 stack of Windtalk|stack each time he gets a kill or an assist that increases his Movement Speed by 8. This effect can stack up to 10 times.
Vale unleashes two wind blades toward the left and right of a target area. each dealing.

Vale sends a whirlwind in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1 second (each enemy can only be knocked airborne 1 time). When the whirlwind reaches its destination, t will remain for 1.6 seconds while continuously dealing a total of to enemies in range.

Vale summons a windstorm at the target location, dealing a total of [] Magic Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 20% while continuously pulling them into its center. After 1.6 seconds, the windstorm will explode, dealing. The remaining whirlwinds will also be pulled into the center.

valentina.description: Valentina gains 8–50 extra EXP each time she deals damage to an enemy hero. Cooldown: 2 seconds. If the enemy hero's level isn't higher than Valentina's, 30% of the damage dealt is converted into her HP. The EXP scales with Valentina's level.

Valentina casts Shadow Strike in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1 second. Enemy heroes hit by Shadow Strike are marked with a Shadow Sigil for 4 seconds and will be terrified for 1s when hit by Shadow Strike again within the duration (a unit can only be terrified once within 4 seconds.

Valentina dashes in the target direction, firing 3 Shadow Bolts at nearby enemies that deal each. Valentina can cast this skill again within 6s (costs Mana). The cooldown of Shadow Strike is reduced by 1 second each time a Shadow Bolt hits an enemy.

valir.description: Valir's skills apply a stack of Ablaze to enemies hit, dealing them Magic Damage equal to 0.6% of their Max HP per second for 4s. At 3 stacks, the fire detonates, dealing Magic Damage euqal to 6% of the target's Max HP to the enemy and stunning them for 1s (the same target can only be stunned by Valir's skills once every 7s.)

Valir launches a fireball that explodes upon hitting the first target, dealing and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The lingering flame on the ground will explode after 1s, dealing Valir recharges 1 fireball every 9s and can hold up to 2 fireball charges. Hitting an enemy hero or Legend Creep with this skill wil immediately restore a fireball charge, while hitting a Minion will restore 50% of the recharge time.

Valir unleashes a torrent of flames in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit and knocking them to the end of its path. Vengeance Flame: The torrent forms a fire wall at the end of its path that lasts 4s and deals to nearby enemies per second. Enemies hit by the torrent or the firewall are slowed by 25% for 1s.

Valir removes all debuffs on himself and conjures 4 Vengeance Flames that last 9s. Each of his subsequent skillls consumes 1 Vengeance Flam to deal 30% extra base damage. The effects of both Burst Fireball and Searing Torrent can be enhanced. Meanwhile, Valir gains 40% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3s.

vexana.description: Vexana and the Eternal Guard inflict Nether Curse on enemies hit. The Curse lasts 5 seconds and will cause the affected enemy to explode upon death, dealing [] to nearby enemies.

Vexana unleashes a Deathly Grasp in the target direction, dealing to enemies in its path. The projectile stops upon hitting an enemy hero, terrifying them and knocking them back, then it explodes, dealing to nearby enemies and terrifying them for 1 second.
Vexana marks the target area with the power of the undead, striking it after 0.8 seconds delay and dealing to enemies hit.

Vexana summons an Eternal Guard at the target location, dealing to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8 seconds. The Eternal Guard then joins Vexana in battle for 15 seconds. Each of Eternal Guard's attacks deals [] to enemies in a large area.

wanwan.description: Enemy heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weakness[es] exposed and position revealed for 5 seconds. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals and increases their damage taken from her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5 seconds. Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her Basic Attack. The dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.

Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering Tiger Pace while dealing to enemies in its path. The Fire Swallow then turns into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will fly back to Wanwan one after another, dealing to enemies on their way back and slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. Enemies hit by the Swallow Dagger twice are immobilized for 0.5 seconds.
Wanwan removes all control effects on herself and triggers Tiger Pace. Meanwhile, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing to enemies hit.

Wanwan leaps into the air and fires arrows at the target enemy hero for 2.5 seconds in rapid succession, dealing per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero in her attack range, gain 30% Attack Speed, and extend the skill duration by 1 second (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan is untargetable and invincible for the duration and can trigger Tiger Pace upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration. Crossbow of Tang|e can only be cast on enemy heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. This damage is regarded as Basic Attack damage, and the firing rate scales with Wanwan's Attack Speed.

x-borg.description: X.Borg's [HP inherits, and his Firaga Armor|e inherits ] and absorbs all incoming damage when it's active. When the Armor is destroyed, X.Borg will disengage from it and roll in the direction of the Joystick (he is immune to damage [and control effects] in this process). The Armor's energy will gradually regenerate [for 3 energy per second] while X.Borg is in the Armorless State. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the Armor and restore it to 30% of his [Armor HP]. X.Borg's skills deal True Damage in Overheated state.
X.Borg sprays fire, dealing 7 times over 2 seconds to enemies in range (75%–100% damage to Minions). Armorless state: The attack area becomes narrower but longer, while the damage is reduced to 60%.

X.Borg shoots 5 Fire Stakes at the edge of the fan-shaped indicator and retrieves them after 1.7 seconds, each dealing and pulling the enemies in the path toward him. Firaga Supplies in the path will also be retrieved if touched by Fire Stakes. Armorless|e State: X.Borg adjusts Fire Stake Launcher to increase its range and shorten the distance between Fire Stakes.

X.Borg charges forward in the target direction while rotating and spraying fire, dealing 12 times and slowing enemies by 25%. He stops upon running into an enemy hero and will slow them by an additional 40%. After 3 seconds from the start of the skill, X.Borg's Firaga Armor will detonate, dealing [ to nearby enemies]. If the Armor is destroyed before it can self-detonate, it will only deal 50% of the damage. When his Armor detonates, X.Borg will dash a short distance in the Joystick's direction and enter Armorless State|e while removing all debuffs from himself. This skill cannot be used in the Armorless State. Use Again: X.Borg stops spraying fire and immediately detonates his Firaga Armor.

xavier.description: Xavier enhances his subsequent skills each time his skill hits an enemy hero. Stage I|e: Increases Movement Speed by 50% when subsequent skills hit, decaying over 1.2 seconds. Stage II|e: Width of subsequent skills will be greatly increased. Stage III: Skill Cooldown reduced by 4 seconds (36 seconds for the Dawning Light). At Stage III, Xavier enters the Transcendence state. Transcendence: All of Xavier's skills are enhanced to Stage III state for 5 seconds (this duration is extend by 1 second each time Xavier's skill hits an enemy).
Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals to enemies it passes through. The Bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the Mystic Barrier|e (up to 5 times).

Xavier conjures a Mystic Barrier|e that lasts 5 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with the Barrier will take and be slowed by 50%, while allies will gain extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2 seconds. When hit by Xavier's other skills, the Barrier expands into a forbidden field for 3 seconds, dealing to enemies within and immobilizing|cc them for 1.2 seconds.
Xavier unleashes a beam of Mystic magic that deals to all enemies along its path. Once cast, he also directly enters the Transcendence|e state and resets the state's duration.

yi-sun-shin.description: Yi Sun-shin attacks with his longbow and glaive according to his distance from the target. Weapon Mastery: After each weapon switch, the next two Basic Attacks will gain extra Attack Speed, dealing 70% and 55% Crit Damage respectively, and gain 15% Movement Speed for 1 second.
Yi Sun-shin dashes forward and slashes with his glaive, dealing and becoming immune to control effects for 1 second. Each Weapon Mastery triggered reduces the cooldown of Traceless by 1 second.

yin.description: If there are no nearby allies within 4 units, Yin's damage is increased to 120% and gains 8% Spell Vamp.

Yin gains 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over 3 seconds). Yin can launch an Basic Attack that deals within the duration. Upon hitting an enemy with the enhanced Basic Attack, Yin will throw another charged punch forward, dealing to enemies in the path. Successfully throwing a charged punch reduces the skill's cooldown|cooldown reduction by 35%.

Yin dashes forward, leaving [Golden Rings] behind while dealing to enemies along the way. He gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 4 seconds if an enemy hero is hit. After 1 second, [Golden Rings] will catch up with Yin, dealing to enemies it passes through and stunning them for 1 second.

After a short delay Yin pulls|cc an enemy (excluding pets and clones|summoned unit) into his domain for up to 8 seconds and turns into Lieh. When in the domain, the two cannot be affected by other heroes' skills. Lieh has stronger skills and gains 50-80 Physical & Magic Defense that lasts for 8 seconds. The domain will end early if any of the two hero is killed. If Lieh successfully kills the enemy, he'll restore 20% Max HP, leave the domain with the cooldowns of Frenzy Strike and Instant Blast (Lieh) reset, and continue to fight as Lieh for 8 seconds. If Yin fails to pull his target into his domain, the skill will enter a 3 second cooldown.

yu-zhong.description: Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue to enemy heroes every time he deals Physical damage to them. Sha Residue erupts upon reaching 5 stacks a target. Then it begins consuming 1 stack every 0.4 seconds to deal equal to to the target. Each stack consumed restores 6% of Yu Zhong's lost HP. When Sha Residue erupts, Yu Zhong also gains 30% Movement Speed by 3 seconds.

Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak and turns it into a weapon, which starts to attack nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of the cloak deals, whereas the sharpened edge deals 275% damage and applies 2 stacks of Sha Residue.

Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul, dealing to all enemies in front and slowing them by 60% for 1 second. Upon target hit, Yu Zhong's next Basic Attack will be enhanced [for 5 seconds], dealing [and behind the target]. (Upon multiple target hit, Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue multiple times with the enhanced Basic Attack, dealing up to 200% damage.)

After channeling for 0.6 seconds, Yu Zhong transforms into his Black Dragon Form. For up to 7 seconds, he cannot use any skills but can move freely and will knock back enemy heroes in this path while dealing gains. He also gains Max HP, becomes immune to control effects, and ignores obstacles in this form. Upon exiting the Black Dragon form, Yu Zhong enters Dragonoid Form, gaining increased range on all of his skills for 10 seconds.

yve.description: Yve gains a stack of Galactic Power|e each time she hits an enemy hero with Void Blast or Void Crystal (up to 10 stacks). Each stack of Galactic Power allows Yve to launch an extra attack on the next Real World Manipulation cast and increases the amount of shield gained by 5%.

Yve detonates Galactic Energy|e at the target location, dealing to enemies in the area Successfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% extra Movement Speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) that decays over 1 second.

Yve summons a Void Crystal|e at the target location, dealing to nearby enemies. Use Again|e: Yve commands the Crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7 seconds, dealing every 0.45 seconds to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an extra 6% for each hit after the first (up to 60%).

Yve creates a Starfield|e that lasts [for] 15 seconds, gaining Displacement Immunity and a. Within the duration, you can Tap or Slide the screen to launch up to 15 attacks. Tap:|e Deals to enemies in the target area. Slide:|e Deals every 0.45 seconds to enemies in the target area for 2.7 seconds and slows them by 50%. Enemies leaving or entering the Starfield are immobilized for 0.8 seconds (only once against the same target). The Starfield will remain if Yve is controlled, expect for suppression.

zetian.description: Phoenix Crown: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with Phoenix Strike or Phoenix Descent, she gains 0.5% Spell Vamp for 5s, stacking up to 10 times. Celestial Robe: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who dares approach her while dealing 90 (+10*Hero Level) to them. She also gains a 300 (+20*Hero Level) Shield that lasts 3s. This effect has a 120s cooldown.

Zetian unleashes a Phoenix Wave in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave, up to 3 times. While casting, Zetian can move with 10% increased Movement Speed and can use other skills. The three Phoenix Waves deal //, respectively. The third wave hits a larger area and includes a small pull effect (not considered a control effect). This skill only has 80% Spell Vamp efficiency against Minions.

Zetian summons a Phoenix Spirit at the target location, dealing and applying a 50% Slow Effect to enemies in the area. The Phoenix Spirit hovers at the location for 3s, dealing every 0.5s and reducing enemies' Magic Defense by 10%. While the Phoenix Spirit is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing and applying a Slow Effect upon arrival.

Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 60% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing and stunning them for 1s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time. Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.

zhask.description: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied Nightmaric Spawn on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that Inherits 55%–100% of his Attributes (HP, Hybrid Defense, Magic Power). Nightmaric Spawn will automatically attack nearby enemies by firing a Death Ray at the target, dealing and slowing them by up to 30% for 0.6 seconds. If Zhask is too far away from Nightmaric Spawn, it will disappear. Death Ray is considered as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit. Fusion Enhanced: The damage of Nightmaric Spawn is increased to 180%, and it can be repositioned.

Zhask fires a penetrating mental missile in the designated direction, dealing. Afterward, Nightmaric Spawn will attack enemies by Mind Eater for and stun for 0.5 seconds. Fusion Enhanced: Increases the damage dealt by Mind eater by.

Zhask selects a designated position to summon Nightmaric Spawn and fuses with it. Nightmaric Spawn can inherit 100% of his attributes and get extra of them. His skills are enhanced during the fusion period. Use Again: Zhask immediately gets off the Nightmaric Spawn and loses enhancement.

zhuxin.description: Every time Zhuxin channels Lantern Flare, she converts the Mana spent into up to 15 Crimson Butterflies to follow her Spirit Lantern. After Zhuxin stops channeling Lantern Flare, the Crimson Butterflies will gradually disappear, each restoring 3% of her Max Mana. Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana, but it doesn't scale with her level.

Zhuxin deals to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack(s) of Soul Snare. Zhuxin also slows all enemy heroes hit by 20%–40% and gains 20%–40% of extra Movement Speed herself for 1.5 seconds.

Hold: Zhuxin can move the Spirit Lantern with the skill button, dealing to all enemies within range every 0.33 seconds (Magic Power increases to 60% against Minions) and applying Soul Snare to enemy heroes hit. Each time (wether it hits a unit or not) consuming 90 Mana. When an enemy hero has 10 stacks of Soul Snare, the Crimson Butterflies will capture them, pulling them airborne for 1 second. Release: Throws all captured enemies to the target location, dealing + 10%-15% of target's Max HP to all enemies in the area. (If an enemy takes damage multiple times, subsequent damage taken will be reduced by 80%.) After a target is captured, Soul Snare cannot stack on them again for 4s. During this time, this skill deals 15% increased damage to that target.
Zhuxin blinks to the target location while gaining a. While flying, she creates a field around her for 6 seconds. The field deals and applies 1 stack of Soul Snare to enemies every 0.5 seconds.

zilong.description: After dealing damage 3 time(s) with Basic Attacks or skills, Zilong triggers Dragon Flurry on the next Basic Attack, hitting the target 3 time(s). Each hit deals Basic Attack Damage and heals himself for. Zilong's Basic Attack deals. If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong skills and Basic Attacks is increased by 30.
Zilong flings the target enemy over his head, dealing.
Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing and reducing their Physical Defense by 15–30 for 2 seconds. The cooldown of Spear Strike is reset each time Zilong kills an enemy.

Zilong removes all slow Effects on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed, 35%–55% Attack Speed, and Slow Immunity for 7.5 seconds. For the duration, he can trigger Dragon Furry after every 2 Basic Attacks (instead of the previous 3).
